160: Denatre tare deinnun chomott dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomottayicha yerushalayim hippekadti shomrim vegomer. umichael kahana rabba illaa mikkulhu natre tare deinnun chomott.

Neshama (deitkere 170) kad nappekatt mehay alma, i zachatt alatt beginta deeden deara denata kudesha bericha hu leruchehon detztzaddikayay kegavvna dehahu ginta deeden dilela. vetamman kol tzaddikayay dealma.

Vechad nishmatta nappekatt mehay alma, alatt bimarta dechappelta detamman ihi pittecha degan eden. pagatt beadam harishon uveinnun avahan detamman, i zachatt ihi, chadan bah uppattechin lah pittechin vealatt. vi la dachyayn lah levar. (uma hi amra kad dechayyin la levar 0 metzauni hashshomrim vegomer azlat. levatar deazlat tamman mikkamme deatya lealma da vihivat ner al resheh shenneemar 1 behillo nero alay rashe kol man dachezaven la mizdazein veamri hazzot noomi. ativat hi veamra 2 el tikrena li nazeamey karan li mara vegomer. ani melea halachti behahu atar verekam hashiveni Adonai belo tora uvelo maasim tovim deail li begufa bisha lamma tikrena li noomi vaAdonai ana bi). vi 7 zachatt ayylatt leginta deeden, kevan deayylatt yatteva tamman beginta (izdavvevgat baalaymalech da mechallon deda ruach izdavvavg borot deda nefesh hashekaleyt) veittelabbeshu (davar acher vaatalebashet) tamman bilvusha dediukena dehay alma veitteaddenatt tamman.

Sittera desitterin lachachime libba ittemasar. (arba) telatt dargin innun deachidan da beda, villen innun neppesh (nishmeta lenishmeta nishmeta illaa deitkere yod) ruach uneshama. (430) nepesh ihu chela deguppa ittebne minneh. dechad bar nash ittear behay alma leizdavvga benukeveh kol shayippe mistakkeme (nusach acher mitkanshe)  umittetakne leittehannaa (lanneshama) tamman, vehahu nepesh ureutta dileh istakkam beh behahu ovada (mammash) umashicha leh lehahu nepesh veail leh tamman behahu zara deoshid.

Umiggo reutta umeshichu denappesha demashicha tamman, ittemshacha chela ochara tamman meinnun dargin deittekrun ishim, veal kolla bimshichu dehahu zara, veittebne minneh guppa. veda ihu chela kadmaa tattaa deinnun (arba) telatt.

Uvegin dehay (nishmeta lenishmeta) nepesh akriv bidvekutta visoda deguppa, karbana deittekriv lechappara al nishmatta itteyhivatt chulaka leinnun dargin deishim (deitkerun ruach venefesh hashekaleyt) vegin dimshichu dechuleka dehahu (neshama) nepesh atte minnayyhu. vehayeynu dichtiv ett karbani lachmi leishay (mahu lachmi leishshay deyahiv mezona leishshay veda hu shefa meor deinnun matehanen mizziv hashshechina) begin dehu kappara denpesh natle chulakehon. vechad mitt bar nash behay alma, hahi nepesh la itteade min kivra lealmin, uvechela da yade mettayay umishtau da im da.

Ruach ihu dimkayyem lannepesh behay alma. veihu meshichu deittearutta denukeva legabbe dechura kad innun betiuveta chada. ucheden ittearatt legabbe dechura betiuveta dilah, lehay ruach kegavvna denukeva legabbe diltatta ashdiatt zara betiuveta legabbe dechura. vesittera da (24 ashedayat shefa betiuveta legabbe nukeba vehacha raza) (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah.

Vehay ruach (436 401 797 lenishmeta kad) nappeka mehay alma (veitparshat minnefesh) (itparshan 15 istallak leginta deeden bishmaya illaa umitlabbesh bediyyukena illaa marekamea bechol gavvnin) al leginta deeden divhay alma (tattaa), veittelabbash tamman go avyra deginta kema demittelabbeshe malache illae kad nachattin lehay alma. begin deinnun mehahu ruach havu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchott vegomer.

Uf hachi rucho mittelabbash began eden deara bediukena dehay alma vetamman itteaddenatt bechol iddunin, began eden da itt tziyyurin vediukenin dehay alma. veitt tziyyurin vediukenin dealma illaa, vetamman kol innun tzaddikayyay azlin umitteaddenin tamman, uveresh yarche veshabbatte innun baaan lesalka leela. (diyyukena da 254 307 divhay alma vabedayvakenaa da ateadenav bechol iddunin uvechol 107 234 718 istelaku 214 436 umitpashshete mehay gufa vametalebashey bediyyukena illaa began eden dilella marekamea bechol gavvnin. bean atar hu 15 bilvusha dileh vaazadevavegav kachada Adonai veinnun nehenin meor hashshechina) uvimtztziutt ginta itt ammuda chada merukkama bechol gevavnin. vehahu ruach kad baa lesalka, ittepashat tamman mehahu levusha (venafsha ishtearat tamman begufa) veal go hahu ammuda (uselekat) vesalik leela go hahu attar denappekatt minneh, kedichtiv veharuach tashuv vegomer.

Venatil lah michael kahana rabba umakriv lah karban busemin kamme kudesha bericha hu, (vaatat) veyatteva tamman umitteaddena behahu tzerora dechayye (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin lo raatta elohim zulattecha vegomer. levattar
161: Nachatta lego ginta deara umitteaddena bechol iddunin, veittelabbeshatt behahu levusha (vaazadevavegaa benefesh dideh) veyatteva tamman betura al chad teren mikkamma dehavatt bekadmitta. (veda hu bachol vaasatelakea bayshaybavet dagan eden umitassek beorayyta uvechol reshe yarche uzemani veshavti nachta izdavvevgat benefesh).

Neshama hi chela illaa al kol illen, veihi mechela didchura raza deilana dechayye. veda salka leela miyyad. vechol hanne (davar acher innun) telatt dargin mittekashrin kechada da beda. vechad mitteparshan kulhu salkin vtavin lehahu attar denappeku minneh.

Kad hay rucha nappekatt mehay alma vealatt bego mearta deadam veavahan tamman, innun yahavin lah pinkas simana vealatt legabbe ginta deeden, kerivatt tamman veashkachatt keruvim vehahu lahat hacherev hammittehappechett. i zachatt chaman pinkas simana uppattechin lah pittecha vealatt. vei la dachyayn lah levar.

Veyatteva tamman, kol hahu zimna deyatteva mittelabbesha tamman bediukena dehay alma. uveresh yarche veshabbatte kad baatt lesalka. tzaddikayyay divginta deeden yahavin lah pinkas simana, vesalkatt behahu ammuda uppagatt beinnun natre chomott yerushelem, i zacha pattechin lah pittecha vealatt. vei la natlin minah hahu pinkas vedachyayn lah levar. tavatt leginta vamra (Shir HaShirim 3:3) metztzauni hashomrim hassovvim bair vegomer nasu ett rediday mealay, da ihu pinkas simana denatle minneh (davar acher minna). shomre hachomott illen innun natre chomott yerushalayim. (kedugema da nishmeta lenishmeta itpashat mehahu levusha dilella umistallek leella leella veithane meor hashshechina. uneshama 2 ishtearat begufa 3 uvechol reshe yarche uzemani veshavti nachta neshama lanneshama vamezadevavegaa lanneshama deishtearat begufa vamezadevavegaa banneshama udeyukena deginta deeden diltatta hu esh umayim shenneemar shamayim. ad hacha rucha dismala hayyoredet lematta azlat ledarga dileh venefesh dileh ashetaaraa begufa deara dichtiv, 4 ach besaro alav yichav vegomer. veal da amro dametaya yade bealma deate maykarea detzaddikayyay umealma tattaa vameshateayyn da im da) (74 kan sitre tora):

Vayyered avram mitzrayma lagur sham. may tama lemitzrayim. ella begin deshakil legan Adonai. dichtiv kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim. detamman shakil venachit chad nahara deihu leyamina dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:11) shem haechad pishon hu hassovev et kol eretz hachavila asher sham hazzahav.

Veavraham kevan deyada veal behemnuta shelemata. baa leminda kol innun dargin deitachadan letatta. umitzrayim hava natil miyyamina (davar acher limina) uvegin kach nachat lemitzrayim. veta chaze, kafna la ishtechach beara ella kad mistalleke rachame min dina:

Vayhi kaasher hikriv lavo mitzrayma. amar rabbi elazar kaasher hikriv, kaasher karav mibbae leh. may kaasher hikriv, ella kedichtiv, (Shemot 14:10) ufaro hikriv deihu akriv lehu leyisrael letiuveta. uf hacha hikriv, deakriv garmeh lekudesha berich hu kedka yeut. lavo mitzrayma leashgacha beinnun dargin uleitrachaka minnayyhu uleitrachaka meovde mitzrayim.

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze, chevan (sefer acher begin) denachat avraham lemitzrayim bela reshu, ishtabidu benoy bemitzrayim arba mea shenin, deha ketiv vayyered avram mitzrayma. vela ketiv red mitzrayim, veitztaar kol hahu lelya beginah desara.

Vayyomer el sara ishto hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare at. vechi ad hahi shaata la hava yada avraham deishsha yefat mare havat. ella ha ukemuha dead hahi shaata la istakkal bediukena desara bisgiut tzeniuta dehavat benehon, vechad kariv lemitzrayim itgalyay ihi vechama bah.

Davar acher bemma yada, ella al yeda detorach orcha bar nash mitbazze vehi kayyma beshappiru dilah vela ishtanni. davar acher hinni na yadati dechama immah shechinta. uvegin kach itrechatz avraham veamar achoti hi.

Umilla da istallak litre gevavnin. chad kemashmao. vechad kedichtiv, (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. uchetiv imri na achoti at. uchetiv, (Devarim Adonai:24) veat tedabber elenu. lemaan yitav li baavurech, kelappe shechina amar baavurech yitav li kudesha berich hu. vechayta nafshi biglalech. begin divda yistallak bar nash veyizke leistalleka learcha dechayye.
Imri na achoti vegomer. rabbi yesa amar yada hava avraham dechulhu mitzrae shetifin innun bezimma, vechevan dechol hay
162: Yada ammay la dachil al itteteh dela ahadar mearcha vela yeul letamman. ella begin dechama shechinta immah:

Vayhi kevo avram mitzrayma vayyiru hammitzrim et haishsha ki yafa hi meod. amar rabbi yehuda beteva ail lah, ufetachu lah lemesav minna kusetuna. kevan deitpattach hava nehora kinhora deshimsha hada hu dichtiv ki yafa hi meod.

May meod, ella dechamu batteva diukena (nusach acher nehora) ochora. appiku lah vechamu lah kemilkadmin hada hu dichtiv vayyiru otah sare faro. kevan dichtiv vayyiru hammitzrim et haishsha may vayyiru otah sare faro, ella deafiku lah vechamu lah kemilkaddemin ucheden vayhallelu otah el paro vegomer. (kan shayych ma 317 daf lach amud bet)

Amar rabbi yitzchak. vavy leinnun chayyayvaya dealma dela yadin vela mashgichin baavidteh dekudesha berich hu, veinnun la mistakkele (becholla) dechol ma dehave bealma meim kudesha berich hu ihu, deihu yada bekadmita ma dilhve besofa dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 46:10) maggid merishit acharit. veihu istache veavid avidan bekadmita begin lesalka lon levatar yomin.

Ta chaze ilmale deinsivat saray legabbe paro, la alke hu, vealkauta da garim alkauta levatar ken deyilkun mitzrayim bingaim gedolim, ketiv hacha negaim gedolim uchetiv hatam (Devarim 6:22) vayyitten Adonai otot umoftim gedolim veraim bemitzrayim. ma lehallan eser makkot af kan eser makkot. kema deavid kudesha berich hu nissin ugevuran leyisrael lelya, uf hacha avad lah kudesha berich hu lesara nissin ugevuran lelya.

Rabbi yose patach veamar (Tehillim 3:4) veatta Adonai magen baadi kevodi umerim roshi. amar david af al gav dechol bene alma yetun laagacha bi kerava, veatta Adonai magen baadi. ta chaze, ketiv magen baadi. amar david lekudesha berich hu, ribbono shel olam mippene ma la avde bi chatima divracha kema dechatme beracha beavraham dichtiv anochi magen lach. veamre magen avraham.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu ledavid, avraham kevar bechantiv utzeraftiv vekaim kammay bekiyyuma shelim. amar leh david i hachi (Tehillim 26:2) bechaneni Adonai venasseni tzarfa chilyotay velibbi. kevan deavad hahi milla devat sheva idkar david kammeh al ma deamar. amar (Tehillim 17:3) bachanta libbi pakadta layla tzeraftanni bal timtza zammoti bal yaavar pi.

Amar ana amina bechanini Adonai venasseni veant bachanta libbi. ana amina tzarfa chilyotay veat tzeraftanni bal timtza la ashkacht li kedka yeut. zammoti bal yaavar pi. man yitten vehay milla dachashavit dela yaavar li pumay,
Veim kol da chatmin beh beracha dekaamaran magen david, uvegin kach amar david veatta Adonai magen baadi, kevod umerim roshi. (davar acher 33 vehay) vadday darga da yekara dili deana mitattarna beh:
Vaytzav alav paro anashim vayshallechu oto. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu ihu magen letzaddikayyay dela yishletun behu bene nasha, vekudesha berich hu agin al avraham dela yishletun beh uveitteteh.

Ta chaze, shechinta la itade minnah desara kol hahu lelya, ata paro lemikrav bahadah, ata malach vealke leh, kol emat deamra sara alke hu malke, veavraham hava matkif bemareh deha sara la yachlin leshaltaa alah hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 28:1) vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach, vehacha nisyona hu dela hirher avatreh dekudesha berich hu.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ta chaze, divgin kach la fakked kudesha berich hu lenachata lemitzrayim ella hu atzmo migarmeh nachat, begin dela yehe pitchon pe livne alma deamar leh ken ulevatar itztaer al itteteh.

Rabbi yitzchak patach veamar (Tehillim 92:13) tzaddik kattamar yifrach keerez ballevanon yisge. tzaddik kattamar yifrach. mippene ma akkish tzaddik letamar. ma tamar kevan degazrin leh la salik ad zeman sagya, uf hachi tzaddik kevan deitavid mealma la salik acher techotoy ad zeman sagya. keerez ballevanon yisge uf hachi name.
Kattamar yifrach ma tamar la salik ella dechar venukeva. uf hachi tzaddik la salik ella dechar venukeva, dechar tzaddik venukeva tzaddeket, kegavvna deavraham vesara.

Keerez ballevanon yisge ma erez ballevanon illaa al kolla vecholla yatve techotoy, uf hachi tzaddik hu illaa al kolla vecholla yatve techotoy. vealma la kayyma ella al tzaddik chad dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam. vealeh kaim alma, uvegineh istemich, vealeh ishtil.
Rabbi yehuda amar veha taninan deal shiva samchin alma kayyma dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:1) chatzva ammudeha shiva. amar leh rabbi yose hachi hu vadday, aval (hacha) kulhu ochoranin bishviaa
163: Kayyme deihu samcha dealma, veihu tzaddik veda ashke (lealma) veravi alma (sefer acher min kolla) vezan kolla. vealeh ketiv (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov ki peri maallehem ychelu. uchetiv, (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kol maasav.

Amar rabbi yitzchak, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. da hu samcha dealma kaim aleh, veihu ashke leginta (deeden) veginta ishtakke minneh uminneh avida perin. vechulhu perin parchin bealma veinnun kiyyuma dealma kiyyuma deorayyta, uman ninhu, nishmathon detzaddikayay deinnun peri ovadoy dekudesha berich hu. uvegin kach bechol lelya velelya nishmathon detzaddikayay salkan.

Vechad itpelag lelya kudesha berich hu ate leginta deeden leishtashea behu. beman. amar rabbi yose bechulhu, ben innun dimdorehon behahu alma, ben innun deyatve bimdorehon behay alma, bechulhu mishtaasha behu kudesha berich hu befalgut lelya.

Ta chaze, alma dilela itzterich leitaruta dealma tattaa, vechad nishmathon detzaddikayay nafke mehay alma vesalke leela kulhu mitlabbeshe binhora dilela bediukena yekar, uvehu kudesha berich hu mishtaasha vetaiv lon deinhu peri ovadoy, veal da ikrun yisrael deit lon nishmatin kaddishin benin lekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, banim vadday ibba deovadoy.

Amar rabbi yesa veafillu innun divhay alma (deara), heach. amar leh begin di befalgut lelya kol innun zakkae keshot kulhu mitare lemikre beorayyta ulemishma tushebchan deorayyta, veha ittemar dekudesha berich hu vechol innun tzaddikaya divgo ginta deeden kulhu tzayytin lekalehon, vechuta dechesed itmeshach alayyhu bimama dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi.

Veal da tushebchan desalkin belelya kammeh da tushebachta shelim. ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael havu segirin bevattehon kad katal kudesha berich hu bechorehon demitzrae, havu amare halela vetushbechan kammeh.

Ta chaze, dedavid malka hava kam befalgut lelya, dei tema dehava yativ o shachiv bearseh vehava amar shirin vetushebchan, la, ella kema dichtiv (Tehillim 119:62) chatzot layla akum lehodot lecha. akum vadday baamida leitasseka beshirin vetushebchan deorayyta.

Uvegin kach david malka chay lealmin, veafillu beyome malka meshicha ihu malka. deha tenan malka meshicha i min chayyay hu david shemeh vei min metayay hu david shemeh, veihu hava itar betzafra ad la yete dichtiv, (Tehillim 57:9) ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar.

Ta chaze, kol hahu lelya desara havat legabbeh defaro atu malache illae lezamra leh lekudesha berich hu beshirin vetushebchan, amar lehu kudesha berich hu kullechu zilu veavidu machteshin ravrevin bemitzrayim, reshimu leman deana zammin lemebad levatar, (da) ma ketiv vaynagga Adonai et paro negaim gedolim vegomer.
Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyikra paro leavram vegomer. mena hava yada, deha la ketiv hacha kema deittemar baavimelech dichtiv veatta hashev eshet haish ki navi hu vegomer, vehacha la amar leh middi.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ha ketiv al devar saray eshet avram. dehachi havu amre leh, al devar saray eshet avram. deha la hava memallel immeh kema dimmallel baavimelech, ella bemilla da ittemar vela yattir, machtesha da al devar saray eshet avram ihi, vela hava mallil (da) immeh, keden yada (hu) deha itteteh deavraham ihi, miyyad vayyikra paro leavram vayyomer vegomer.

Vaytzav alav paro anashim. lamma begin dela yikrav bar nash behu leavasha lon. vayshallechu oto, levayay avadu leh bechol ara demitzrayim. amar leh kudesha berich hu hachi ant zammin lemebad livnoy at tozif lon mearach dichtiv, (Shemot 13:17) vayhi beshallach paro et haam deozif lon mikkol areh.
Amar rabbi abba kol kach lamma izdammen leh leavraham ulemay itzterich, ella begin legaddela shemeh deavraham vesara bealma,
164: Deafillu bemitzrayim deinnun chorashe alma vela hava yachil bar nash leishteziv minnayyhu. itgaddal avraham veistallik leela hada hu dichtiv vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim, lean atar hannegba. (umay hu veishto vechol asher lo, ella leodaa dela gezelo minneh middaam meinnun mattenan deyahavu leh bedil sara datehaa lemalka)
Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, kolla raza dechachmeta ihu, veka ramaz hacha bechachmeta vedargin diltatta deka nachit avraham leumekayyay dilhon veyada lon, vela itdabbak behu, vetav lekamme mareh.

Vela itpatta behu keadam dechad mata lehahu darga itpatta benachash vegarim mota lealma. vela itpatta kenoach dechad nachat umata lehahu darga ma ketiv, (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo. oholo ketiv beHei.

Aval beavraham ma ketiv vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim. desalik vela nachit, vetav leatreh ledarga illaa deitdabbak beh bekadmita. veovada da hava, begin leachazaa chachmata deitkayyaym bekiyyuma shelim kedka chaze leh vela itpatta vekam bekiyyuma vetav leatreh. hannegba, da darom darga illaa deitachid beh bekadmita dichtiv haloch venasoa hannegba. uf hacha hannegba, atar deitdabbak beh bekadmita.

Ta chaze, raza demilla, i avram la yechut lemitzrayim vela yitztaref tamman bekadmita. la yehe chulak adveh bekudesha berich hu. kegavvna da livnoy kad baa kudesha berich hu lemeobbad leh (davar acher lon) amma chada amma shelim ulekarva lon legabbeh, i la nachatu bekadmita lemitzrayim vela yitztarfun tamman, lo havu amma yechida dileh.
(61 1) Kegavvna da i la ityeyhivat ara kaddisha lichnaan bekadmoyta veyishlot bah la havt ara chulekeh veadveh dekudesha berich hu. vcholla raza chada.

Rabbi shimon hava azil bearcha, vehava immeh rabbi elazar bereh verabbi abba verabbi yehuda. ad dehavu azle, amar rabbi shimon tavavhna hech bene alma la mashgichin leminda mille deorayyta val ma kayyme. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:9) nafshi ivviticha ballayla af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, hay kera ukemuha veokimna leh, aval ta chazi, nafsha debar nash, kad (ihu) salik learseh, nafkat minneh vesalka leela. vei tema dechulhu salkan. lav kol chad vechad chame appe malka, ella nafsha salka vela ishtaar bah bahade gufa bar chad reshimu (nasheymev) dekuysta dechayyuta delibba.

Venafsha azla uvaya lesalka. vechamma dargin ledargin lesalka, shatat vehi itarat behanne kumerin tehirin dimsaavuta. i hi dechiat dela istaavat bimama salka leela. vei lav dechiat, istoovat benayyhu veitdabbekat behu vela salka yattir.

Vetamman modae lah millin veihu itdabbekat meinnun millin dizman kariv. ulezimnin dechayychin bah umodain lah millin kedivin. ucheden azla kehay gavvna kol lelya ad deyitar bar nash vetavat leatrah. zakkain innun tzaddikayay degale lon kudesha berich hu razin dileh bechelma begin deyistammerun min dina. vavy leinnun chayayve alma dimsaavin garmayyhu venafshayyhu.
Ta chaze, innun dela istaavu, kad salke bearsayyhu, nafsha salka vealat ben kol hanne dargin bekadmita vesalka vela itdabbekat behu. ulevatar azla veshatat vesalka kefum orchah.

Hahi nafsha dezachat lesalka itchaziat kammeh disvar appe yomin veitdabbekat biruta leitchazzaa betiuveta illaa lemecheme benoam malka ulevakkera behechaleh. veda hu bar nash deit leh chulaka tadir bealma deate.

Veda hi nafsha dichsifa dilah kad salka bekudesha berich hu (tadir), vela itdabbekat behanne zinin tehirin acharanin, vehi azlat batar zina kaddisha beatra (davar acher batar atra) denafkat mittamman. uvegin kach ketiv nafshi ivviticha ballayla. begin lemirdaf batrach vela leitpattaa batar zina ochora nucheraa.
Ta chaze, nafshi da nefesh deihi shalta ballayla ulemirdaf batar darga. ruach bayyom, dichtiv nafshi ivviticha
165: Ballayla, da nefesh deihi shalta ballayla. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka. da ruach deihu shalta bimama.
Vei tema ditren dargin innun bifruda, lav hachi, deha darga chad innun, veinnun teren bechibbura chad. vechad illaa deshalta alayyhu veitdabbak behu veinnun beh (veikrun) veitkeriat neshama,

Vechulhu dargin salkan beraza dechachmeta, dechad mistakkelan illen dargin yistakkel bar nash bechachma illaa, vehay neshama ayil behu umitdabbekan bah, vechad hay shalta keden hahu bar nash ikre kadosh shelim mikkolla. reuta chada legabbe kudesha berich hu.

Nefesh ihu itaruta tattaa veda semicha begufa vezanat leh, vegufa achid bah vehi itachadat begufa. levatar ittaknat veitavidat kurseyay leashraa alah ruach beitaruta dehay nefesh deitachidat begufa, kema dichtiv, (yeshaya lev) ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom.
Levatar dimtakkeni tarvavyyhu, zeminin lekabbela neshama. deha ruach itavid kurseyay legabbe neshama leashraa aleh, vehay neshama ihi setima illaa al kolla temira dechol temirin.

Ishtechach deit (la) kurseyay lekurseyay vekurseyay legabbe illaa alayyhu. vechad tistakkal bedargin tishkach raza dechachmeta behay milla. vecholla hu chachmeta leitdabbeka behay gavvna millin setimin.

Ta chaze (leel oz 2) nefesh ihi itaruta tattaa deitdabbeka beh begufa. kegavvna dinhora devutzina. dinhora tattaa deihi uchema itdabbekat biftila vela itperash minnah vela ittaknat ella bah. vechad ittaknat bappetila itavidat kurseyay linhora illaa chivvavra desharyay al hahu nehora uchema.

Levatar kad mittaknan tarvavyyhu itavidat hahu nehora chivvavra kurseyay linhora setimaa dela itchaze vela ityeyda ma deshara al hahu nehora chivvavra. ucheden nehora shelim. vechach hu bar nash deihu shelim becholla. ucheden ikre kadosh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 16:3) likdoshim asher baaretz hemma vegomer. kegavvna da beraza illaa.

Ta chaze, beshaata deal avraham leara, itchaziyi leh kudesha berich hu kema deittemar dichtiv laAdonai hannire elav, vekabbil tamman nefesh uvana mizbeach lehahu darga. levatar haloch venasoa hannegba dekabbil ruach. levatar (74) desalik leitdabbeka go neshama keden vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai setam, da hi neshama deihi setima dechol setimin.

Levatar yada devae leitzterafa uleitattera bedargin, miyyad vayyered avram mitzrayma, veishteziv mittamman. vela itpatta go innun tehirin, veittzarif vetav leatreh. kevan denachat veittzarif, miyyad vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim, salik vadday vetav leatreh veitdabbak bimhemnuta illaa dichtiv hannegba.

Mikkan ulehala yada avraham chachmeta illaa veitdabbak bekudesha berich hu veitavid yamina dealma. keden veavram kaved meod bammikne bakkesef uvazzahav. kaved meod besitra demizrach. bammikne besitra demaarav. bakkesef missitra dedarom. bazzahav missitra detzafon.

Atu rabbi elazar verabbi abba vechulhu chavraya uneshaku yedoy. becha rabbi abba veamar vavy vavy kad tistallak min alma man yanhir nehora deorayyta. zakkaa chulakhon dechavrayay deshamin millin deorayyta illen mippumach.

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyelecha lemassaav, lemifkad atreh vedargoy. lemassaav lemassao ketiv, man massao. da darga kadmaa deitchaze leh bekadmita, ketiv hacha massao uchetiv hatam (Melachim 1 6:7) even shelema massa nivne. veha okimna even shelema vadday. massa kema deittemar.
Vayyelecha lemassaav. (ayyen 90 62 haggilgulim daf 6 73 sof 80 6) kol innun dargin darga batar darga kema deittemar. minnegev
166: Vead bet el leatkana atreh ulechabbera lon beyichuda shelim. deha minnegev vead bet el ishtechach raza dechachmeta kedka yeut.

El hammakom asher haya sham oholo battechilla, oholo beHei, man oholo, da bet el. even shelema kidamaran. tu reshim veamar el mekom hammizbeach asher asa sham barishona dichtiv laAdonai hannire elav. ucheden vayyikra sham avram beshem Adonai. keden itdabbak bimhemnuta shelemata.

Ta chaze, bekadmita salik mittatta leela dichtiv vayyera Adonai el avram. uchetiv laAdonai hannire elav. veda hu darga kadmaa kidamaran even shelema (massa nivne uchetiv lamesaav). ulevatar haloch venasoa hannegba. darga batar darga ad deitattar baddarom chulakeh veadveh. levatar satim milla kad salik veamar laAdonai setam, da alma illaa. umittamman natil bedargin venachit meela letatta veitdabbak kolla beatreh kedka yeut.

Vehacha kad tistakkel bedargin tishkach raza dechachmeta illaa. ma ketiv vayelech lemassaav minnegev missitra deyamina sheruta dealma illaa setima amika leela ad en sof, venachit darga batar darga (74) minnegev vead bet el meela letatta.

Uchetiv vayyikra sham avram beshem Adonai adbak yichuda beatreh kedka yeut dichtiv el mekom hammizbeach asher asa sham barishona. may asher asa sham, desalik lah mittatta leela. vehasheta nachit bedargin meela letatta, begin dehi la taade meinnun dargin illain, veinnun la yaadun minnah, veyityached kolla beyichuda chada kedka yaot.

Keden itattar avraham vehava chulak adveh dekudesha berich hu vadday. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay demitattere beh bekudesha berich hu vehu mitatter behon. zakkain innun bealma den vezakkain innun bealma deate. alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. uchetiv, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom.

Azlu, kad matu bechad be chakal yatvu. patach rabbi shimon veamar (Tehillim 25:16) pene elay vechanini vegomer. hay kera it leistakkala beh, veha okimna leh bechamma atar. aval behay kera millin setimin it beh. pene elay. vechi david amar pene elay vechanini.

Ella begin darga dileh deihu itattar beh kaamar. tena uzcha leavdecha, tena uzcha da oz illaa kedichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:10) veyitten oz lemalko. man malko da melech setam malka meshicha. uf hacha leavdecha da malka meshicha kidamaran melech setam.

Vehoshia leven amatecha, vechi la hava bereh deyishay ihu ad deihu amar bishma deimmeh vela bishma deavoy. ela ha okimna dechad yete bar nash lekabbel milla illaa leidkara, bae lemehach bemilla deihu vadday. veal da adkar leimmeh vela leavoy. vetu ha taninan (davar acher 33 deha) deda melech kidkaamaran.

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, ma ketiv vayhi riv ben roe mikne avram, riv ketiv chaser yod, devaa lot lemehdar lefulechana nucheraa defalche yatve ara, vesofeh dikra ochach dichtiv vehakkenaani vehapperizi az yoshev baaretz.

Umenalan delot ahadar lesarchaneh lefulechana nucheraa, dichtiv vayyissa lot mikkedem. may (leel ad 2) mikkedem, mikkadmono shel olam. ketiv hacha vayyissa lot mikkedem uchetiv vayhi benasam mikkedem ma lehallan netilu mikkadmono shel olam uf hacha ken.

Kevan deyada avraham delot lehachi nate libbeh. miyyad vayyomer avram el lot vegomer hippared na mealay. let ant keday leitchabbera bahaday. keden itperash avraham minneh vela baa lemehach uleitchabbara immeh, dechol man deyitchabbar lechayyayva sofeh lemehach avatreh uleitannash
167: Menalan mihoshafat deitchabbar im achav veilmale zechu deavahan itannash tamman dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 18:31) vayyizak yehoshafat. ucheden ishteziv dichtiv vaysitem elohim mimmennu.

Veal da la baa avram lemehach bahadeh delot. veim kol da la baa lot lemehdar missurechaneh ella vayyivchar lo lot et kol kikkar hayyarden. vayyissa lot mikkedem itnetil min kadmaa dealma vela baa leitdabbeka bimhemnuta shelemata keavraham.

Avram yashav beeretz kenaan. leitdabbeka beatra dimhemnuta uleminda chachmeta leitdabbeka bemareh. velot yashav beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad sedom. im innun chayyayvin dealma denafku miggo mehemnuta dichtiv veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod. kol chad itperash learcheh kedka yeut. vegin kach zakkain innun chavrayay demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velelya, vechavruta dilhon bekudesha berich hu. vealayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom:

VaAdonai amar el avram achare hippared lot meimmo vegomer. rabbi abba patach (Yona 1:3) vayyakam yona livroach tarshisha millifni Adonai vegomer. vavy leman deistattar mikkamme kudesha berich hu dichtiv beh (yremayhakeg) halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male neum Adonai vehu ate lemeerak mikkammeh.

Ella ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:14) yonati bechagve hassela beseter hammadrega. yonati da keneset yisrael. bechagve hassela da yerushelem deihi salka al kol alma. ma sela ihi illaa vetakkifa al kulla uf yerushelem ihi illaa vetakkifa al kolla. beseter hammadrega da (bet hammikdash) atar deikre bet kodesh hakkodashim libba dechol alma.

Uvegin kach ketiv beseter hammadrega begin detamman havat shechinta mistattera keitteta deihi tzenua levaalah vela nafka mibbeta levar. kema deat amar (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriya beyarkete vetecha vegomer. kach keneset yisrael la sharyay levar meatraha bistiru dedarga ella bezimna degaluta deihu bego galuta, uvegin deihi begaluta, shear ammin it lon tivu veshalva yattir.

Ta chaze bezimna deyisrael sharyayn al ara kaddisha kolla hava mittakkan kedka yeut, vekurseyay shelim alayyhu, veavde pulechana uvaka avirin dealma vesalik hahu pulechana leela leatreh, begin deara la ittaknat lefulechana ella leyisrael bilchodayyhu. uvegin kach shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot havu mitrachake dela havu shaltin bah kidhashta begin dela itzanu ella mittamtzit.

Vei tema ha chamenan kamma malchin havu deshallitin bezimna devet hammikdash kayyaym al alma. ta chaze, bevayit rishon ad la seivu yisrael ara, la havu shaltin shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ella itzanu mittamtzit uvah havu shaltin velav kol kach. kevan dechavu yisrael vesaivu ara keden kivyachol dachu lah lishchinta meatrah veitkarvat leducheta ochora, ucheden shaltin shear amin veityeyhiv lon reshu leshaltaa.

Ta chaze, ara deyisrael la shallit alah memanna ochora bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. uveshaata dechavu yisrael vehavu mekatrin letaavavn ochoranin bego ara, kivyachol iddachyay shechinta meatrah umashche umekatre leitkashra taavavn ochoran go shechinta, ucheden ityeyhiv lon shaltanuta, begin diktoret kitra hu leitkattara. ucheden shaltu shear ammin, uvatlu neviim, vechol innun dargin illain la shaltu beara.

Vela aadiu shaltanuta dishar ammin begin deinnun mashchu lishchinta legabbayyhu. veal da bevet sheni ha shuletanuta mishar amin la aadiu vechol shekken begaluta dishchinta bishar ammin atar dishar memannan shaltin uvegin kach kulhu yankin min shechinta deitkerivat gabbayhu.
168: Da bezimna deyisrael havu sharan al ara ufalche pulechana dekudesha berich hu, shechinta havat tzenua benayyhu vela nafkat miggo beta levar beitgalyay. uvegin kach kol innun neviim dehavu behahu zimna la natlu nevua ella beatrah kidkaamaran. uvegin kach yona hava arak levar meara kaddisha, dela yitgele aleh nevua vela yehach bishlichuta dekudesha berich hu.

Vei tema ha chaminan deitgalleyay shechinta bevavel deihu levar. ha okimna dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1) hayo haya, dehava ma dela hava min kadmat dena miyyoma deitbeni be makdesha, vehahi nevua leshaata havat

Uchetiv al nehar kevar, nahar dichvar hava miyyoma deitbere alma, ushechinta itgalleyay tadir aleh dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan umishsham yippared vegomer. (sham haechad vego) veda ihu chad minayyhu.

Vetamman itgalleyay shechinta lefum shaata deitzterichu lah yisrael lefum tzaarayyhu. aval bezimna ochora la itgalleyay. uvegin kach yona begin dela tishre aloy shechinta vela titgele aleh, azal meara kaddisha vearak. hada hu dichtiv (Yona 1:10) millifne Adonai. uchetiv ki yadu haanashim ki millifni Adonai hu boreach.

Ta chaze, kemma dishchinta la itgalleya ella beatra deitchaze lah, uf hachi la itchaze vela itgalleya ella bebar nash deitchaze lah. deha min yoma desalik al reuteh delot leithappecha besurchaneh, istalkat rucha kaddisha meavraham. vechad istallak lot minneh, miyyad shara ruach kudesha beducheteh hada hu dichtiv vaAdonai amar el avram achare hippard lot meimmo vegomer.

Ta chaze, kevan dechama avraham delot hava tav lesurchaneh, hava dachil avraham. amar dilma chas veshalom begin chavruta deda avidna begineh chulaka kaddisha deaatar li kudesha berich hu. kevan deitperash minneh amar leh sa na enecha uree min hammakom asher ata sham.

May min hammakom asher atta sham deitdabbekat beh bekadmita veitatterat behemnuta shelemata. tzafona vanegba vakedma veyama. illen innun massaav dehavu bekadmita dichtiv vayyelech lemassaav. uchetiv haloch venasoa hannegba. illen dargin illain deitattar bimhemnuta shelemata bekadmita.

Ucheden itbassar dela yaade minneh umin benoy lealmin dichtiv ki et kol haaretz asher atta roe. may asher atta roe. da darga kadmaa deitgalleya leh kema deat amer laAdonai hannire elav. uvegin kach asher atta roe begin dedarga da kadmaa itkelil mikkulhu dargin vechulhu itchazun beh, uvegin kach ki et kol haaretz asher atta roe vegomer.
Rabbi elazar iara beve ushepiza belud, vehava immeh rabbi chizkiyya. kam belelya lemile beorayyta, kam rabbi chizkiyya gabbeh. amar leh rabbi elazar bekistera dekuseta chavrayy shechiche.

Patach rabbi elazar veamar (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer. ketappuach, da kudesha berich hu, deihu chamid umitattar bigvavnoy mikkol shear ilanin dela it dedame leh. rashim ihu mikkolla, rashim hu delet ochora kavvateh.

Begini kach betzillo chimadti. betzillo vela betzilla ochora. betzilo vela vetzilla dishar memannan. chimmadti, ematay, min yoma dehava avraham bealma deihu chamid verachim leh lekudesha berich hu beahava kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 41:8) avraham ohavi. ufiryo matok lechikki, da hu yitzchak deihu ibba kaddisha.

Davar acher betzillo chimadti veyashavti, da yaakov. ufiryo matok lechikki, da yosef hatztzaddik deavad perin kaddishin bealma. veal da ketiv (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef. dechol innun toldot deyaakov (yosef deihu deavid toldot) (nusach acher beyosef hatztzaddik kayyme, deavid toldot keen kullehu) (davar acher 33 shevatim), uvegin kach ikrun yisrael al shema deefrayim dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:20) haven yakkir li efrayim vegomer.
Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar. da avraham. dedame leh letappuach desalik rechin
169: Veitreshim bimhemnuta shelemata al kol bene dareh, veitreshim chad leela, veitreshim chad letatta dichtiv (Yechezkel 33 24) echad haya avraham.

May tama hava echad. dela hava ochora bealma di salik limhemnuta dekudesha berich hu bar ihu. amar leh rabbi chizkiyya veha ketiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan. amar leh ad kean innun la havu bedargin ilain deitattar behu avraham.

Levatar amar leh tu shemana dela ikre avraham echad ad deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov. kevan deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov (nusach acher veha) vehavu kulhu telathon avahan dealma keden ikre avraham echad. ucheden hu tappuach bealma rashim mikkol bene alma. amar leh shappir ka amart.

Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar da kudesha berich hu. ken dodi da kudesha berich hu. betzillo da kudesha berich hu. chimadti veyashavti, beyoma deitgele kudesha berich hu al tura desinay vekabbilu yisrael orayyta veamru (Shemot 24:7) naase venishma.

Ufiryo matok lechikki. illen millin deorayyta dichtiv behu (Tehillim 19:11) umetukim middevash venofet tzufim. davar acher ufiryo matok lechikki, illen nishmathon detzaddikaya dechulhu ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu vekayyme immeh leela.

Ta chaze, kol nishmatin dealma deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu kulhu chad beraza chad, vechad nachate lealma kulhu mitparshin bigvavnin dechar venukeva, veinnun dechar venukeva mechubbarin kechada.

Veta chaze, tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura avid nefesh. ureuta detiuveta didchura legabbe nukeva veitdabbekuta dileh bah, appik nefesh vechalil tiuveta (nusach acher tiuveteh) denukeva venatil lah. veitkelil) tiuveta tattaa betiuveta dilela veitavidu reuta chada bela piruda.
Ucheden (natil) kalil kola nukeva veitabberat min dechura vetiuvetin detarvavyyhu mitdabbekan kechada, veal da kolla kalil da beda. vechad nishmatin nafkin dechar venukeva kechada nafkin.

Levatar kevan denachate mitparshan da lesitra da veda lesitra da, vekudesha berich hu mezavvivg lon levatar. vela ityeyhiv ziuuga leochora ella lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, deihu yada ziuuga dilhon lechabbera lon kedka yaot.

Zakkaa hu bar nash dezache beovadoy veazil beorach keshot begin deitchabbar nefesh benefesh kema dehava meikara, deha i zache beovadoy da hu bar nash shelim kedka yeut. uvegin kach ketiv ufiryo matok lechikki. dehu betikkuna mevorach leitbarcha minneh alma, begin decholla beovadin devar nash talya i zache i la zache.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya hachi shamana dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:9) mimmenni peryecha nimtza. kudesha berich hu amar leh lichneset yisrael mimmenni vadday peryecha nimtza. peryi nimtza la ketiv ella peryecha. hahu tiuveta denukeva deavid nefesh veitkelil betukefa diddechura veitkelil nefesh benefesh veitavidu chad kalil da beda kidamaran. levatar ishtakkachu tarvavyyhu bealma, veda bechela didchura ishtechach ibba denukeva.
Davar acher betiuveta denukeva ishtechach ibba didchura. dei lav tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura la itavidu perin lealmin hada hu dichtiv mimmenni peryecha nimtza:

Vayhi bime amrafel melech shinar vegomer. rabbi yose patach (Yeshayahu 41:2) mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo vegomer. hay kera ukemuha chavrayay. aval hay kera beraza dechachmeta ihu. deha taninan shiva rekiin avad kudesha berich hu leela, vechulhu leishtemoda yekara dekudesha berich hu, vechulhu kayymin leodaa raza dimhemnuta illaa.

Ta chaze, it rekia illaa satim leela minnayyhu deinnun shiva, veda hu rekia dedabbar lon venahir lon lechulhu, veda la ityeyda, vekayyma bishelta dela yedia, begin deihu satim veamik, vecholla tevavhin aleh, uvegin kach ikre mi, kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Iyov 38:29) mibbeten mi yatza hakkarach veittemar, vehay hu rekia illaa
170: Veit letatta rekia deihu tattaa mikkulhu vela nahir, uvegin deihu tattaa dela nahir, hahu rekia dealayyhu itchabbar beh, veillen teren atvavn kalil lon begavveh veikre yam, dehahu rekia illaa deikre mi.

Begin dechol innun rekiin ochoranin itavidu nachalin vealin legabbeh, ucheden ihu yam illaa veavad ibbin venunin liznayyhu, veal da amar david (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 41:2) mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo. mi heir mimmizrach. da avraham. tzedek yikraehu leraglo. (nusach acher da sara, davar acher tzedek yikraehu leraglo vegomer) da hu rekia tattaa dechulhu rekiin deitavid yam. yitten lefanav goyim. man hay, hu rekia tattaa deamaran deavid nukemin veappil sanin. uvehay ishtabbach david veamar (Tehillim 18:41) veoyvay natatta li oref umesanay atzmitem.

(Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten lefanav goyim. illen innun ammin dehava radif alehon avraham vekudesha berich hu hava katil lon. (umelachim yarad. 1 illen Melachim dimmanan leella alayyhu. yitten lefanav goyim, illen ammin diltatta) umelachim yard illen memannan ravrevan dilela. dechad avid kudesha berich hu dina bealma (davar acher beamma) becholla avid dina beela vetatta.

Yirdefem yaavor shalom orach beraglav lo yavo. yirdefem da avraham. deavraham hava radif lon, vekudesha berich hu hava avar kammeh vekatil lon. dichtiv yaavor shalom da kudesha berich hu deikre shalom.

Orach beraglav lo yavo. vechi salka datach dehava avraham azil bego anane o bego susevavn uretichin. ella orach beraglav lo yavo, dela hava azil kammeh deavraham la malacha vela shelicha ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy dichtiv orach beraglav. man raglav illen malachin deinnun techotoy dekudesha berich hu kema deat amer, (Zecharya 14:4) veamdu raglav bayyom hahu vegomer.

Davar acher mi heir mimmizrach. ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu itar alma leayytaa leavraham ulekarva leh legabbeh, hay itaruta begin dezammin yaakov lemeppak minneh ulekayyma teresar shivtin kulhu zakkain kammeh dekudesha berich hu.

Tzedek yikraehu leraglo. dekudesha berich hu hava kare leh tadir min yoma deitbere alma kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 41:4) kore haddorot merosh, uvegin kach tzedek yikraehu vadday. leraglo, leitchabbera beh befulechaneh ulekarva leh legabbeh. kema deat amer, (Shemot 11:8) haam asher beraglecha.

Davar acher mi heir mimmizrach. demittamman sheruta dinhora leanhara. begin dedarom hahu tukefa dileh miggo mizrach ihu. veal da mi heir hahu nehora dedarom. mimmizrach, begin deihu natil veittezan bekadmita, vetiuveta dehahu rekia illaa lemehav leh lemizrach.

Tzedek yikraehu leraglo. da maarav, deihu kare leh tadir vela shachich kema deat amer (Tehillim 83:2) elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el. begin demaarav itar tadir legabbeh. yitten lefanav goyim umelachim yard. deha minneh kabbil tukefa leachnaa kol innun ammin dealma.

Rabbi yehuda amar (Yeshayahu 41:2) mi heir mimmizrach, da avraham dela natil itaruta legabbe kudesha berich hu ella mimmizrach, begin dechama shimsha denafik betzafra missitra demizrach, natil itaruta lenafsheh deihu kudesha berich hu. amar da hu malka devara yati. pelach leh kol hahu yoma, leramsha chama shimsha deitkenish (veyarcha nafkat) vesihara nahara. amar da hu vadday deshallit al hahu pulechana defalachit kol hay yoma, deha itchashach kammeh vela nahir. palach leh kol hahu lelya.

Letzafra chama deazla chashocha veitnehir sitra demizrach. amar vadday kol illen malka it alayyhu veshallit deanhig lon. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu tiuveta deavraham legabbeh, keden itgale aloy umallil immeh, dichtiv tzedek yikraehu leraglo. demallil immeh veitgele aleh.
Rabbi yitzchak patach (Yeshayahu 45:19) dover tzedek maggid mesharim.
171: Kudesha berich hu kol milloy innun bekusheta, veavid mesharim, bemma avid mesharim. begin dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma, la hava kaim vehava mitmotet lehacha ulehacha. amar leh kudesha berich hu lealma, ma lach deat mitmotet. amar leh, ribbono shel olam la yachilna lemekam delet bi yesoda al ma deitkayyaym.

Amar leh ha ana zammin lemekam bach chad tzaddik deihu avraham di yarchim li. miyyad kaim alma bekiyyumeh hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram al tikra behibbaram ella beavraham. beavraham mitkayyem alma.

Amar rabbi chiyyay (Yeshayahu 45:19) maggid mesharim. deha ativ leh alma lekudesha berich hu hahu avraham zammin hu deyifkun minneh benin deyacharivu makdesha veyokidu orayyta. (nusach acher lenafka minneh yishmael, amar leh ha yitzchak, amar leh zammin lemeppak minneh asu chayyayva daychareb bi makdesha veyokid orayyta), amar leh zammin chad bar nash lemeppak minneh deihu yaakov veyifkun minneh teresar shivtin kulhu zakkain. miyyad itkeyyaym alma begineh hada hu dichtiv maggid mesharim.

Rabbi elazar amar ha atarna vaydabber vayyagged vayyomer kulhu letaamayyhu mitparshan. vaydabber ihu beitgalya darga levar, dela ihu darga penimaa keinnun dargin illain, veda ihu (yeshaya ma) dover tzedek.

Vayyagged ihu remez ledarga penimaa illaa deshaltaa al dibbur, veda hu maggid mesharim. man mesharim da darga illaa deyaakov sharyay beh hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 99:4) atta konanta mesharim. uvegin kach maggid ketiv, vela ketiv dover.

Amar rabbi yitzchak veha ketiv, (Devarim 4:13) vayyagged lachem et berito. amar leh hachi hu vadday ihu darga deshalta al tattaa deihu dover tzedek. vecholla (bah) ihu (nusach acher laashatelaa ibba) leistakkala (ikka) hacha. (nusach acher atya) ta chaze, deaf al gav dedibbur ihu tattaa, la tema dela illaa ihu, ella vadday dibbur malyay ihu mikkolla vedarga illaa ihu. vesimanich (Devarim lak) ki lo davar rek hu mikkem.

Rabbi elazar hava azil leve chamoy, vehavu immeh rabbi chiyyay verabbi yose verabbi chizkiyya. amar rabbi elazar ha chamena deitaruta dilela lav ihu ella kad itar letatta, deha itaruta dilela betiuveta diltatta talyay (milleta).

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 83:2) elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el. da hu itaruta diltatta begin leshaltaa. amar david, elohim al domi lach, leatara legabbe illaa uleitchabbera gabbe yamina.

May tama begin (Tehillim 83:6) ki hinne oyvecha yehemayun vegomer (uchetiv) ki noatzu lev yachdav alecha berit yichrotu, uvegin kach elohim al domi lach leatara legabbe ela, deha keden itarat yamina uketirat lah bahadah. vechad itkashrat beyamina keden itbar sanin dichtiv (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev.

Veta chaze beshaata deitchabbaru kol innun malchin leaggacha kerava aleh deavraham, ityayatu leaavara leh min alma, vechevan deshaltu belot bar achuha deavraham miyyad azlu, dichtiv vayyikchu et lot veet rechusho ben achi avram vayyelechu. may tama, begin dediukeneh delot hava dame leavraham, uvegin kach vayyelechu, dechol hahu kerava begineh hava.

May tama. begin dehava avraham appik bene alma mippulechana nucheraa veail lon befulachana dekudesha berich hu. vetu kudesha berich hu atar lon bealma begin legaddela shema deavraham bealma ulekarva leh lefulechaneh.

Veraza demilla kevan deavraham itar lemirdaf abbatrayyhu keden elohim al domi lach ad deitkashshar kolla beavraham, vechad itkashshar kolla beavraham keden itbaru kulhu malchin mikkammeh kedka amaran dichtiv yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev vegomer:

Umalki tzedek melech shalem hotzi lechem vayayin. rabbi shimon patach veamar (Tehillim 76:3) vayhi beshalem sukko vegomer. ta chaze kad salik biruta dekudesha berich hu lemivre alma chad shalhova devutzina dekardinuta. uneshaf zika bezika chashchat veokidat. veappik miggo
172: Sitre tehoma chad tif vechibber lon kechad uvara behu alma.
Hahu shalhova salik veitattera bissemala, vehahu tif salik veitattar beyamina, salku chad bechad ichlafu duchete da lesitra da veda lesitra da, denachit salik udesalik nachit.
Itkatteru da beda, nafik mibbenayyhu ruach shelim. keden innun teren sitrin itavidu chad veityeyhiv benayyhu veitatteru chad bechad. keden ishtechach shelam leela ushelam letatta, vedarga itkayyaym.

Itatterat hei beVav vav beHei, keden salka hei veitkashshera bekishshura shelim. keden umalki tzedek melech shalem. melech shalem vadday melech ihu deshallit bishlimu, ematay ihu melech shalem beyoma dechippure dechol anpin nehirin. (davar achar malche tzedek melech shalem, amar rabbi shimon baa kudesha berich hu lemeppak kehunata mishsham kema deat amar baruch avram leel elyon, kevan deakdim bircheta deavraham levirchata demareh, ameraz leh avraham vechi makdimin bircheta deavda levirchata demareh, miyyad ityehivat kehunata leavraham dichtiv, 0 neum Adonai ladoni shav limini. uchetiv batreh nishba Adonai velo yinnachem atta kohen leolam al dibbarti malche tzedek, dichtiv vehu kohen leel elyon, veen zaro kohen)

Davar acher umalki tzedek. da alma batraa. melech shalem, da alma illaa. deitattar chad bechad bela piruda teren almin kechada, veafillu alma tattaa kolla hu. vechad milla ihu. hotzi lechem vayayin ditre illen beh. vehu chohen leel elyon meshammesh alma lokovel alma. vehu chohen da yamina. leel elyon alma illaa. uvegin kach bae kahana levarcha alma.

Ta chaze, birchan (davar acher 33 24) natil hay alma tattaa kad itchabbar bechahana rabba keden vayvarachehu vayyomar baruch avram (vego) leel elyon hachi hu vadday. kegavvna da bae kahana letatta lekashra kishrin ulevarcha hay ducheta begin deyitkashshar beyamina leitkashshera teren almin kechad. baruch avram raza demilla tikkuna devirchan ihu.

Barucha avram kema deamrinan baruch atta. leel elyon. Adonai elohenu. kone shamayim vaaretz. melech haolam. vehay kera raza devirchan ihu. (uvegin kach) vayvarachehu mittatta leela. uvaruch el elyon (asher magen tzarich beyadcha). meela letatta. vayyitten lo maaser mikkol leitdabbeka beatar dekishshura itkkashshar letatta.
Ad dehavu azle, iara behu rabbi yesa vechad yuday bahadeh. vehava amar hahu yuday (Tehillim 25:1) ledavid elecha Adonai nafshi essa. ledavid. vechi ammay la ketiv mizmor ledavid o ledavid mizmor.

Ela begin dargeh kaamar ledavid tushebachta deamar begineh elecha Adonai nafshi essa. elecha Adonai leela. nafshi, man nafshi, (eshsha) da david (hu) darga kadmaa dekaamaran. essa, asallek. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 121:1) essa enay el heharim. begin dechol yomoy dedavid hava mishtaddel lesalka dargeh leitattera leela uleitkashshera tamman bekishshura shelim kedka yeut.

Kegavvna da (Tehillim 103:1) ledavid barchi nafshi et Adonai begin dargeh kaamar, umay amar barchi nafshi et Adonai. et leitkashshera bekishshura leela. vechol keravay, man keravay. illen shear chevan bera. deikrun keravayim kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:4) umeay hamu alav. davar acher barchi nafshi, begineh kaamar. et Adonai da shelimu decholla, et Adonai kelala decholla.

Amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yesa chamina lach deha im shechinta kaatit veitchabbarat. amar leh hachi hu vadday, utelat parse hu deazilna bahadeh veamar li kamma mile maalyayta veana agirna leh leyoma da vela yedana deihu botzina denahir kidchamina hasheta.
Amar leh rabbi elazar lehahu yuday ma shemach, amar leh yoezri. amar leh yoezer veelazar (milla chada) yetivan kechada, yatvu gabbe chad tinnara
173: Behahu chakal. patach hahu yuday veamar (Yeshayahu 43:25) anochi anochi hu moche feshaecha lemaani vechattotecha lo ezkor. may tama tere zimne anochi anochi.

Ella chad besinay vechad beshaata devara alma, dichtiv (Shemot 20:2) anochi Adonai elohecha da hu besinay. vechad kad bera alma dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 45:12) anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati. hu, begin leachazaa dela have piruda ben ela vetatta.

Moche feshaecha. maavir peshaecha la ketiv, ella moche. begin dela yitchazzun lealmin. lemaani. may lemaani, begin innun rachamin detalyayn bi dichtiv, (Devarim 4:31) ki el rachum Adonai elohecha vegomer.

Davar acher moche feshaecha lemaani. ta chaze (leel 84 2) chayyayve alma avdin pegimuta leela, dechad innun chovin salkin rachamin unehiru illaa veyanniku devirchan la nachit letatta, vehay darga la natil birchan dilela leyannaka letatta. uvegin kach lemaani begin dela yitmanun birchan leyannaka (leh) lecholla.
Kegavvna da (Devarim lak) reu atta ki ani ani hu. leachazaa dela have piruda ben ela vetatta kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kegavvna da kad ishtakkachu zakkain bealma itaru birchan lealmin kulhu. kevan deata avraham itar birchan lealma dichtiv vaavarechcha vehye beracha. may vehye beracha. remez deyishtakkechun begineh birchan leela vetatta dichtiv venivrechu vecha vegomer uchetiv vaavarcha mevarachecha.

Ata yitzchak oda lecholla deit din veit dayyayn leela leitpara merashshiaya, veihu itar dina bealma begin deyidchalun leh lekudesha berich hu kol bene alma. ata yaakov veitar rachame bealma veashlim mehemnuta bealma kedka chaze.

Beyome deavraham ma ketiv umalki tzedek melech shalem, deitatterat kurseyay beducheteh, ucheden ishtechach melech shalem bela pegimu kelal. hotzi lechem vayayin deappik mezonin lealmin kulhu kedka chaze. hotzi lechem vayayin dela itmenau birchan mikkulhu almin. hotzi kema deat amer, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz midargin dilela appik mezonin uvirchan lealmin kulhu.

Vehu chohen leel elyon deishtechach kolla bishlimu illaa kedka chaze. leitchazaa kema dechayyayvaya avde pegimu bealma umane birchan. hachi name begin zakkain atyayn (atechazeyan) birchan lealma, uveginayyhu itbarchan kol bene alma:

Vayyitten lo maaser mikkol. may maaser mikkol meinnun birchan denafke mikkol. begin deihu atar dechol birchan denachate lealma mittamman nafke. davar acher vayyitten lo maaser mikkol. kudesha berich hu yahav leh maasra. uman ihu, da darga dechol pitchin dimhemnuta uvirchan dealma beh kayyme veihu maaser veihu chad measara veihu asara mimmea. mikkan ulehala al avraham bekiyyuma dilela kedka chaze.

Amar leh rabbi elazar shappir ka amart. amar leh rabbi elazar may avidtach, amar leh karyana dardeke beatri, hasheta ata rabbi yose dichfar chanin lemata useliku lon migabbay veotvu lon legabbeh. vehavu yahavin li kol beni mata agra kehahu zimna dedardeke havu gabbay. veistakkalna benafshay dela itchaze li leithanne minnayyhu lemaggana, vaagirna garmay bahade dehay chakkim. amar rabbi elazar birchan deabba itzterichu hacha.

Kamu. atu kammeh derabbi shimon (levatar), vehava yativ velae kol yoma kammeh derabbi shimon. veyoma chad hava asik bintilat yadayim kammeh. amar kol man dela natil yedoy kedka yeut, af al gav deitannash leela itannash letatta, umay onsheh letatta, degarim leh legarmeh miskenuta. kema deonsheh kach, hachi hu zache man denatil yedoy kedka yeut degarim legarmeh birchan dilela desharan birchan al yedoy kedka yeut, veitbarach beutera.
174: Levatar akdim rabbi shimon chama leh deantal yedoy bemaya venatil lon beshiura sagyay demayin. amar rabbi shimon malle yadav mibbirchotecha. vechach hava, mehahu yoma ulehala itattar veashkach sima vehava lae beorayyta veyahiv mezona lemiskene kol yoma, vehava chade immehon umasbar lon anpin nehirin. kara aleh rabbi shimon (Yeshayahu 41:16) veatta tagil baAdonai bikdosh vegomer, (chaser)

Achar haddevarim haelle haya devar Adonai el avram vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach (Shir HaShirim 7:11) ani ledodi vealay teshukato. ha ukemuha, aval beitaruta diltatta ishtechach itaruta leela, deha la itar leela ad deitar letatta. uvirchan dilela la mishtakkeche ella bame deit beh mammasha velav ihu rekanya.

Menalan meeshet ovadyahu deamar lah elisha (Melachim 2 4) haggidi li ma yesh lach babbayit. deha birchan dilela la sharyayn al patora rekanya vela beatar rekanya. ma ketiv vattomer en leshifchatcha kol babbayit ki im asuch shamen. may asuch. ella amra leh shiura dehay mishcha lav ihi ella kede meshichat etzbea zeira.

Amar lah nichamtani. deha la yedana heach yishrun birchan dilela beducheta rekanya, aval hasheta deit lach shemen, da hu atar leishtakkacha beh birchan. minnalan dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov vegomer vesefeh ma ketiv, (Tehillim 133:3) ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam. uveatra da sharan birchan. (veittemar).

Vei tema (Tehillim 133:3) ketal chermon sheyyored al harere tziyyon vela ketiv shemen ela tal. ella ihu shemen veihu tal. hahu tal ihu deattil kudesha berich hu mimmishcha illaa. dehahu shemen nafak lesitra deyamina.

Teren innun yayin veshemen. veazlu litren sitrin. yayin listar semala shemen listar yamina. umissitra deyamina nafke birchan lealma umittamman itmeshach malchuta kaddisha uvegin deshemen hava ittakkan letatta bekadmita, shemen izdamman leela ariku devirchan.

Sitre tora achar haddevarim haelle vegomer. illen pittegame orayyta, dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:19) ett haddevarim haelle dibber Adonai el kol kehalchem. ma lehallan pittegame orayyta, uf hacha pittegame orayyta. battar deishtaddal bar nash behay alma baddevarim haelle, kudesha bericha hu mevaser leh veakdim lah lenishmatta shelam (besorot tovot), hada hu dichtiv al tira avram anochi magen lacha. mikkol zayynin bishin degehinnom.

Secharcha harebe meod begin dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta behay alma zache veachsin yerutta achsanta bealma deatte kema dichtiv (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yish. may yesh (da 310 meen telat asar nahare deafarsemona dachya 1 deyahave leh achsanta illaa bealma deate) (nusach acher da alma deate). veotztzerottehem amalle, behay alma meuttera umikkol tivu dealma. man deazil leyamina zache lealma deatte, uman deazil lismala ha uttera bealma den, (deit semala kaddisha veit semala misava, veda hu deamrinan man demitasak beorayyta yahave leh orech yamim bealma deate, veyahave leh asar vechavod bealma din shenneemar 3 orech yamim biminah vegomer, uman deyitree daytahenay gufa bealma din velo itassak beorayyta uveovadin tavin, yahave leh utera bealma din missitra dismala missitra deyetzer hara, vabeavetarea da avid bish yarit gehinnam. vei tema vechi lo it bealma din utera missitra dikdushsha, en, dechol hamekayyem et hattora meavoni sofo lakeyymah maaser, veda hu utera tava demistera dikdushsha).

Rabbi abba kad atta mehattam, hava machriz man bae uttera uman bae orcha dechayye bealma deatte yette veyishtaddal beorayyta. havu mittekanshin kule alma legabbeh. ravvavk chad hava beshivvutteh. yoma chad atta legabbeh, amar leh rabbi baena lemile beorayyta kede sheyyihye li uttera. amar leh ha vadday. amar leh ma shemecha. amar leh deazil leyamina zache lealma deatte, uman deazil lismala ha uttera bealma den, (deit semala kaddisha veit semala misava, veda hu deamrinan man demitasak beorayyta yahave leh orech yamim bealma deate, veyahave leh asar vechavod bealma din shenneemar 0 orech yamim biminah vegomer, uman deyitree daytahenay gufa bealma din velo itassak beorayyta uveovadin tavin, yahave leh utera bealma din missitra dismala missitra deyetzer hara, vabeavetarea da avid bish yarit gehinnam. vei tema vechi lo it bealma din utera missitra dikdushsha, en, dechol hamekayyem et hattora meavoni sofo lakeyymah maaser, veda hu utera tava demistera dikdushsha). rabbi abba kad atta mehattam, hava machriz man bae uttera uman bae orcha dechayye bealma deatte yette veyishtaddal beorayyta. havu mittekanshin kule alma legabbeh. ravvavk chad hava beshivvutteh. yoma chad atta legabbeh, amar leh rabbi baena lemile beorayyta kede sheyyihye li uttera. amar leh ha vadday. amar leh ma shemecha. amar leh yose. amar lon letalmidoy deyikrun leh rabbi yose mare deuttera vykara. yattiv vitteassak beorayyta.
Leyomin hava kaim kammeh, amar leh rabbi an hu uttera. amar
175: Dehay shemen dilela kay learaka al david ushelomo leitbarcha (al) benoy. mena lan dichtiv vayyaamod hashshemen. ketiv hacha vayyaamod. uchetiv hatam (Yeshayahu 11:10) shorsh yishshay asher omed lenes ammim.

Ta chaze, mishshulchan delechem happanim devirchan nafkin mittamman umezona lealma, la vae leishtakkacha rekanya afillu riga chada, begin dela yistallekun birchan mittamman, uf hachi la mevarchin al shulchan rekanya, deha birchan dilela la sharyayn al shulchan rekanya.
Ta chaze, ma ketiv ani ledodi vealay teshukato, ani ledodi bekadmita ulevatar vealay teshukato. ani ledodi leatkana leh ducheta bekadmita. ulevatar vealay teshukato.

Davar acher ani ledodi. deha taninan shechinta la ishtakkechat imhon dechayyayvaya, kevan deate bar nash leitdakkaa ulemikrav gabbe dekudesha berich hu keden shechinta sharya aleh. hada hu dichtiv ani ledodi bekadmita, vealay teshukato levatar. ate bar nash leitdakkaa medakkein leh.

Ta chaze, achar haddevarim haelle deradaf avraham batar illen malchin vekatil lon kudesha berich hu, hava avraham tohe, amar dilma chas veshalom garaana hahu agra dahavena ahadar bene nasha legabbe kudesha berich hu veachidna behu lekarava lon legabbeh vehasheta itketilu bene nesha al yadi. miyyad amar leh kudesha berich hu al tira avram anochi magen lach secharcha harebe vegomer. agra kabbilat alayyhu, deha kulhu la yizkun lealmin.

Haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze lemor, may bammachaze, ella behahu chezu darga dechol diukenin itchazzeyayn beh. amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, ad la itgezar avraham hava chad darga mallil immeh, uman ihu da machaze dichtiv, (Bamidbar 24:4) machaze shadday yechoze.
Kevan deitgezar havu kulhu dargin sharan al hay darga, ucheden mallil immeh hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 6:3) vaera
Shema minah dela leshem shamayim ka avid, veal leidreh, shema chad kala dehava amar la taansheh (tuv legabbeh) degavra rabba lihevi. tav legabbeh, amar leh tiv beri tiv veana yahivna lacha uttera.

Adhachi atta gavra chad umana depaz bideh, appekeh unepal nehora bevetta. amar leh rabbi baena lemizke beorayyta veana la zachina, uvaena man deyishtaddal beorayyta begini. deha itt li uttera sagge deka shevak li abba, dechad yattiv al petoreh hava mesaddar aleh telesar kasse meillen. uvaena lemizke beorayyta veana yahivna uttera.

Amar leh lehahu ravvavk tishtaddal beorayyta veda yahiv lacha uttera, yahav leh hahu kassa depaz. kara aleh rabbi abba (Iyov 28:17) lo yaarchenna zahav uzechuchitt uttemurattah keli paz. yattiv velaa beorayyta vehahu bar nash hava yahiv leh uttera.

Leyomin al chamidu deorayyta bimoy. yoma chad hava yattiv vehava bache. ashkecheh rabbeh dehava bache, amar leh al ma ka bachitt. amar leh uma mannachno chayye dealma deatte begin hay, la beena ella lemizke legabbay. amar hasheta shema minah deha leshem shamayim ka avid.

Kara leh lehahu gavra, amar leh tol utteracha vehav leh leyatteme ulemiskeni, veana yahivna lacha chulak yattir beorayyta bechol ma deanan laan. ahadar leh rabbi yose hahu kassa depaz, vead yoma la aade shemeh, umin benoy ben pazzi, vehayeynu rabbi yose ben pazi, vezacha lechamma orayyta hu uvenoy (begin daleaa beorayyta). delett lacha agar tav bealma keman delae beorayyta umekayymah:

Achar haddevarim haelle haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze lemor vegomer, bechol attar dichtiv beorayyta bammachaze da shema deittegle laavahan, uman ihu, shadday, shenneemar (Shemot 6:3) vaera el avraham el yitztzechak veel yaakov beel shadday. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 24:4) asher machaze shaday yechoze. veda ihu chezu dechol chezvavn illain ittechazzeyayn miggavvih, kehay mare dechol diukenin ittechazzeyayn beh vcholla chad. mare machaze chad hu, da targum veda lashon hakkodesh.

Amar rabbi yose saggiin innun beorayyta, veal da hava leh roshu leuneklus letargem behahu lishna degale kudesha bericha hu beorayyta. velishna da sattim ihu miggo malache ilaa, bammachaze (deha) dehava sattim mimmalache illae dela yade beda kad memallel beh beavraham.
May tama, begin deavraham la hava mahul vehava arel sattim bisra. uvegin kacha hava sattim minnayyhu bilshon targum. kegavvna da bilam dichtiv
176: El avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday vead la itgezar la havu innun dargin sharan aloy lemallala.

Vei tema deha bekadmita ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram uchetiv vayyisa avram haloch venasoa hannegba uchetiv vayyiven sham mizbeach ha hacha innun dargin illain. vehasheta amaran dead la itgezar la havu innun dargin illain sharan al hay darga lemallala immeh.

Ta chaze, bekadmita yahav kudesha berich hu chachma leavraham leminda chachma leitdabbeka beh veyada raza dimhemnuta, aval lemallala immeh la hava ella hay darga tattaa bilchodoy, kevan deitgezar, kulhu dargin illain havu sharan al hay darga tattaa begin lemallala immeh, ucheden istallak avraham becholla kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, ad la itgezar bar nash la itachid bishma dekudesha berich hu, kevan deitgezar al bishmeh veitachid beh. vei tema avraham deitachid beh ad la itgezar. hachi hava deitachid beh vela kedka yeut, deha miggo rechimuta illaa derachim leh kudesha berich hu kariv leh.

Levatar pakkid leh deyitgezar veityeyhiv leh berit. kishshura, dechulhu dargin illain. berit kishshura leitkashshera kolla kechada leachlala da beda, berit kishshura decholla itkeshar beh. uvegin kach avraham ad la itgezar. milloy la hava immeh ella bammachaze kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu alma la itberi ella al berit kema deat amer bere shit bara elohim, vehayeynu (davar acher 33 berit) deal berit kiyyem kudesha berich hu alma, uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. deha berit kishshura ihu deyoma velelya la mitparshan.

Amar rabbi elazar kad bera kudesha berich hu alma al tenay hava, dechad yetun yisrael im yekabbelun orayyta yaot. veim lav hari ana ahadar lechu letohu vavohu. vealma la itkeyyaym ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay vekabbilu orayyta ucheden itkeyyaym alma.

Umehahu yoma ulehala kudesha berich hu bari almin. uman innun, ziuugin divne nasha. deha mehahu zimna kudesha berich hu mezavvevg ziuugin veomer bat peloni lifloni. veillen innun almin dehu bare. ta chaze, anochi magen lach. anochi da hu darga kadmaa deitachid beh bekadmita:

Asher machaze shadday yechozhi, yecheze. sattim hava milla miggo malache hasharett begin dolo yehe lon pitra dekudesha bericha hu memallel behahu arel mesoova (74 2, 75 2) deha malache kaddishe lav (yikron) nizkakin billeshon targum.

I tema dela yade, veha gavriel olif leyosef 70 lashon, vtargum chad me lashon hu, ella minda yade aval la nizkakin tenan, dela chayyshe vela mashgichin aleh deha mais ihu kammayyhu mikkol shear lashon.

Vei tema hoil umais ihu mimmalache illae, ammay tirgem uneklus orayyta behay lashon, veyonattan ben uziel hammikra. ella mais hu kammayyhu vhachi itztzetricha, delett kina lemalache illae bahadayyhu deyisrael (ella orayyta, veilmale havo yade shevache deorayyta hava lehu kina bahadayyhu deyisrael) yattir, veal da targum tora umikra kacha, vela mais ihu deha bechamma duchete kattav kudesha bericha hu beorayyta hachi.

Uvegin kacha sattim ihu miggo malache illae kaddishe. veal da ittegli beh beavraham beorach sattim dela yishgechun beh malachin kaddishin vela yehe lon pitra, dekudesha bericha hu ittegli al bar nash arel.
Emattay ittegli leh beittegalleya demalache illae, kad yahiv leh beritt keyayma kaddisha dichtiv vaydabber itto elohim lemor, elohim shema dekudesha velo ketiv bammachaze. shema beittegalleyay.

Lemor may lemor, lemor uleachraza bechol lashon dela tehe beittekasya, lav belishna ochora, ella belishna decholla mishtayayn bah deyachle lememar da leda vela yachle lekatrega ulememar pitra, veal da vaydabber itto elohim lemor. elohim velo machaz. begin dehava meayyil leh bivritt keyayma kaddisha vekariv leh legabbeh.

Rabbi yehuda amar vegin kacha att Adonai la itteyyhav leh ad deittegazzar, may tama deihi mammash beritt ikre. veal da kevan deal bivritt keden itteyyhivatt leh att hei. dichtiv ani hinne beritti ittacha vehayitta leav hamon goyim velo yikare od shimcha avram vegomer:

Achar haddevarim haelle. rabbi chiyyay hava azil lemecheme lerabbi elazar, pega beh rabbi chaggay, amar leh hay archa dimtakno kammeh demar lean ihu azil, amar leh lemecheme lerabbi elazar, amar leh veana name ezil bahadacha, amar leh i techul lemisbar sevara lemay detishma zil vei lav tuv avatteracha, amar leh lo lichush mar lehay, deha ana shemano kamma raze deorayyta veyachilna lemekam behu.
Pattach rabbi chaggay veamar, may dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:2) ett karbani lachmi leishay

Vayyomer avram adonay Adonai ma titten li. 65 alef dalet 106 yod. elohim yod hei 22 hei. (nusach acher elohim Adonai baneykevad elohim) ella raza demilla, chibbura ditren almin kechada alma tattaa vealma illaa.

Ma titten li veanochi holech ariri. delet li bar, veolifna dechol man delet leh bera behay alma ikre ariri kema deat amer, (Vayikra 20:21) aririm yihyu. veavraham al ma amar milla da deamar ma titten li. kivyachol keilu la heemin beh bekudesha berich hu.

Ella amar leh kudesha berich hu anochi magen lach behay alma. secharcha harebe meod bealma deate. miyyad itar avraham beraza dechachmeta veamar ma titten li, deha yedana dela kabbil agar lemeal beh behahu alma bar nash dela olid bar, veal da amar ma titten li veanochi holech ariri, deha la titten li dela zachina beh. mikkan debar nash dela zache bivnin behay alma la zache behahu alma leaala go pargoda.
Veavraham hava chame beitztagninut dileh dela yolid. ma ketiv vayyotze oto
177: Vegomer. ett karbani da karban bisra deittekrav lechappara dama al dama bisra al bisra, begin dechol karbanin lav mittekarvin ella al bisra lechappara al bisra.

Vehachi shemana i bar nash chata behema ma chatatt, dekudesha bericha hu amar (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban vegomer. ammay, ella kudesha bericha hu avid ruach bene nasha veruach habbehema, veapperish da min da. uvegin kacha (Kohelet 3:21) ruach bene haadam haola hi lemala veruach habbehema vegomer vday mitteprash da min da.

Ad la chata adam ma ketiv, (Bereshit 1:29) vayyomer elohim hinni nattatti lachem ett kol esev zorea zara vegomer uchetiv lachem yihye leachla velo yattir. kevan dechata veyetztzer hara ishtaiv beguppa dileh, uvechol innun toladin avad behu dina.

Ulevattar atta noach vchama deha guppa ittebne meattera deyetztzer hara, akriv karban kema deakriv adam, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 8:21) vayyarach Adonai ett reach hannichoach vegomer. (uchetiv) ki yetztzer lev haadam ra minneurav. amar kudesha bericha hu mikkan ulehala hoil veguppa ishtaiv mehahu yetztzer hara, yitteannag guppa kema deittechaze leh yechul bisra. keyrek esev nattatti lachem ett kol.

Kad achil bisra. mehahu bisra itteannag bisra dileh veittearav da beda veitterabbe guppa minneh, umehahu oneg guppa chata bechamma chetin. amar kudesha bericha hu kappara al guppa bisra. bisra achil uvisra itterabbe mineh uveh chata. vegin kacha lechappara al guppeh bisra. uvisra deachil bisra avid dama leguppa (begin kach dema deishtear mehahu bisra deachil bisra eved dema legufa) vegin kacha dama deishtaar mehahu bisra levar itteattad lechappara al dama deitteavid mehahu bisra dileh dichtiv, (Vayikra 17:11) ki haddam hu bannepesh yechapper.

Ketiv karbani, uchetiv karbanchem dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:2) takrivu ett karbanchem, ma ben hay lehay, ella karbani. kegon shelamim deatteyayn al shalom. karbanchem, kegon chataott vaashamott deatteyayn al chet vasham, vegin kacha ett karbani bisra. lachmi nahama vechamra. reach da ketorett. nichochi da nachatt ruach deavid kahana birutta dishma kaddisha, velevae birutta deshir ushevacha.

Tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado. bemoado may havi, i tema bechol yoma babboker uvaerev, may ihu bemoado (nusach acher may arya deihu moado), ella moado deshalta behahu zimna raava. reu deishtechach leela bedarga yedia. veal da ketiv bemoado.

Kad karban ittekriv. kolla natlin chulaka, veittebadderan kelippin lechol sitra, veyichuda ittekriv veitteyaychad uvotztzinin ittenaharin veishtechach raava ureu bechol almin vekudesha bericha hu ishtechach beraza deyichuda chada kedka chaze. atta rabbi chiyyay uneshakeh, amar leh yaott ant beri minni lemehacha lemecheme leh lisvar anpin deyomin. (406 patach veamar david malka deihu reviaa veihu even maasu habbonim) (nusach acher amay david malka achsin malchuta deihu reviaa deihu even maasu habbonim).

Azlu, kad matun legabbeh, chama lon yatteve al tara, amar leh leshammosho zil veema lon hay kurseyay dittelatt kayymin mahu kol echad (sefer acher kolla chad). amru leh zil veema leh lemar delav lemaggana amar david malka deihu reviaa even maasu habbonim. amar leh zil veema lon dean gaalu beh bedavd deihu amar even maasu habbonim.

Ahadar rabbi chiyyay resheh legabbe rabbi chaggay veamar leh shamatt behay midi. amar shemano behay kera dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:6) "bene "immi "nicharu vi samuni vegomer. dehay kera shelomo malka amaro, veal david malka ittemar kad dachu leh achuhi minnayyhu.

Vetu shemana may chama kudesha bericha hu lemehav malchutta lihuda mikkol achuhi, ella attevavn dishmeh chakikan beh, vekudesha bericha hu yahav yekara lishmeh uvegin kacha achsin malchutta. vetu shemana yehuda ha attevavn dishmeh vadday, 4 letteh ammay. ella da david malka deittekashar bishmeh mikkol bene alma dichtiv, (Hoshea 3:Adonai) uvikkeshu ett Adonai elohehem veett davd malkam vegomer ha david kashir bishmeh, tu deihu kesher shel tepillin vday 4 davd malka (davar acher kesher shel tefillin vadday), uvegin kacha david ittekashar bishmeh.

Alu, kevan dealu yetivu kammeh, ishtik rabbi elazar veinnun ishtiku. al rabbi elazar leidreh shema chad kala dehava amar zil veema lon ma deinnun bayayn dichsherin innun. ahadar legabbayyhu. amar lon itt man dishma milla lema li. amru leh anan mechakkan leanhara miggo tzachutta devutztzina illaa usevara
178: Pattach veamar, (Chavakuk 2:20) vaAdonai behechal kadsho has mippanav kol haaretz. kad bae kudesha bericha hu lemivre alma, istakkal go machashava raza deorayyta verashim rishumin velo hava yachil lemekam, ad devara teshuva deihi hechala penimaa illaa veraza setima vetamman ittershimu veittetztzayyru attevavn begilluppayyhu.

Kevan deittebre da hava mistakkal behay hechala verashim kammeh tziyyurin dechol alma dichtiv has mippanav kol haaretz reshim kammeh reshumin vetztziyyurin dechol alma. bae lemivre shamayim ma avad istakkal beor kadmaa veitteataf beh uvera shamayim. dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:2) ote or kashalma veachar kacha note shamayim kayria.

Istakkal lemebad alma tattaa avad hechala ochara veal beh uminneh istakkal ureshim kammeh kol almin letatta uvera lo. hada hu dichtiv vaAdonai behechal kadsho has mippanav kol haaretz. has mippanav, 65 rashim kammeh kol nekudin dechol alma deinnun shittin vechamesh, kechusheban 65, shittin innun vechamesh innun, vechulhu rashim kammeh kad bera alma. vegin kacha yekara dekudesha bericha hu lav ihu ella leinnun deyadin archoy umehachin bah beorach keshot kedka yeutt.

Adhachi dehava mishtae bahadayyhu, atta nura veaschar leh, veinnun yattevu levar. shemau chad kala dehava amar i kaddisha heviani hammelecha chadarav bechol innun idrin desava deanpin ulema kaddisha (nusach acher ulemta kadeyshetaa) deittemsaru mappetchan dilhon bideh, vechulhu metaknan lacha uleinnun divginacha. uvechayyaycha kaddisha kol chela dishmaya nagila vnismecha vacha.

Kad chamu illen hachi, izdazou, udechilu saggi nappal alayyhu, amre, lett anan chazyayn lehay, nippuk mikkan venehacha leorchin, (azlu) yattevu tamman kol hahu yoma vela yachilu lemecheme leh, veamru lett reutta dekudesha bericha hu denettiv hacha nappeku mittamman veazle.

Ad dehavu azle patach rabbi chiyyay veamar (Tehillim 103:20) barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael mikkol shear ammin dealma dekudesha bericha hu itterae behu mikkol shear ammin veavad lon chulekeh veachsanteh, veal da yahiv lon orayyta kaddisha, begin dechulhu havu birutta chada al tura desinay vakdimu asiyya lishmia.

Kevan deakdimu oshoyya lishmia kera kudesha bericha hu lepammalya dileh amar lon ad hacha attun havittun yechidain kammay bealma, mikkan ulehala ha banay beara chaverim bahadayyhu becholla. lett lechu roshu lekadsha shemi ad deyisrael yittechabberun bahadayychu beara, vechulhu tehevon kechada chaverim lekaddesha shemi, begin deakdimu asiyya lishmia kegavvno demalache illae avde birkia dichtiv barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro. ose devaro bekadmitta ulevattar lishmo.

Davar acher barchu Adonai malachav. illen innun tzaddikaya beara deinnun chashuvin kamme kudesha bericha hu kemalache illae birkia, begin deinnun gibbore choach demittegabbere al yitztzerehon kegibbar tav demittegabber al saneh. lishmoa bekol devaro. dezachan bechol yoma lemishma kala milleela beshaatta deitztzetrichu.

Hasheta man yachil lemekam bahadayyhu deinnun kaddishin elyonin, zakkain innun deyachle lemekam kammayyhu, zakkain innun deyachle (davar acher 33 leman deyechul) leishtezava mikkammayyhu, ashgachutta dekudesha bericha hu alayyhu bechol yoma, hecha anan yechilan lemeal kammayyhu. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar uttekarev yishkon chatztzerecha uchetiv (Tehillim 84:6) ashre adam oz lo vacha vegomer, (74 kan sitre tora):
179: Hachutza vegomer. (amar leh kudesha berich hu 91 meitztagninut dilach avram eno molid avraham molid). amar leh kudesha berich hu la tistakkal behay ella beraza dishmi yehe lach bar. hada hu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha. raza dishma kaddisha demittamman itkashshar leh beda (bara) vela missitra ochora.

Ko dehu tara litzlota, bah yishkach beracha, bah yishkach bar nash sheilteh. ko hahu sitra deatyay missitra digvura, deha missitra digvura ka ata yitzchak. vehahu sitra digvura ko ikre demittamman atyayn ibbin ufere lealma, vela missitra diltatta dechochvaya umazzalot.

Keden veheemin baAdonai. itdabbak leela vela itdabbak letatta. veheemin baAdonai vela bechochvaya umazzale. veheemin baAdonai, deavtach leh deyasge agreh lealma deate. veheemin baAdonai, behahu darga deityeyhiv leh demittamman yete leh zara leolada bealma. vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka.
Vayyachsheveha lo deaf al gav deihi dina keilu hi rachame hay ko. davar acher vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka, dekashir kishra illaa betattaa lechabbera lon kechada.

Ta chaze, ha itaru avraham molid avram eno molid, vechi tema deha olid yishmael beod deihu avram. ella hahu bera deavtach leh kudesha berich hu la olid beod deihu avram, deha beod deihu avram olid letatta, kevan deitkere avraham veal babberit keden olid leela, uvegin kach avram eno molid bekishshura illaa, avraham molid kema deamaran, veitkashshar leela beyitzchak:

Vayhi avram ben tishim shana vetesha shanim vegomer. rabbi abba patach (Shmuel 2 22:32) ki mi el mibbalade Adonai umi tzur vegomer. david malka amar hay kera (Tehillim 18:32) ki mi el mibbalade Adonai. man hu shallita o memanna deychul lemebad middi mibbalade Adonai, ella ma deitpakkad meim kudesha berich hu, begin dechulhu la birshutayyhu kayyme vela yachle lemebad middi. umi tzur, uman ihu takkif deyachol lemebad tukefa ugevura miggarmeh mibbalade elohenu. ella kulhu bida dekudesha berich hu vela yachil lemebad middi bar birshuteh.

Davar acher ki mi el mibbalade Adonai. dekudesha berich hu kolla birshuteh vela keman deitchaze bechezu dechochvaya umazzale, dechulhu achzeyayn milla, vekudesha berich hu achlaf leh legavvna ochora. umi tzur zulati elohenu. ha ukemuha delet tzayyayr kema dekudesha berich hu deihu tzayyayr shelim avid vetziyyer diukena go diukena veashlim lehahu diukena bechol tikkuneh, veail bah nefesh illaa dedame letikkuna illaa, vegin kach let tzayyayr kekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, mehahu zara debar nash kad itar tiuveteh legabbe nukeveh venukeveh itarat legabbeh keden mitchabberan tarvavyyhu kechada venafak minnayyhu bar chad dechalil mitteren diukenin kechad. begin dekudesha berich hu tziyer leh betziyyura deitkelil mittarvavyyhu. veal da bae bar nash lekadsha garmeh behahu zimna begin deyishtechach hahu diukena betziyyura shelim kedka chaze.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ta chaze, kamma innun ravrevin ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, deha umenuta vetziyyura debar nash ihu kegavvna dealma, uvechol yoma veyoma kudesha berich hu bare alma mezavvivg ziuugin kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, vehu tziyyer diukenehon ad la yetun lealma.

Ta chaze, deamar rabbi shimon, ketiv ze sefer toldot adam. vechi sefer hava leh. ella ukemuha dekudesha berich hu achme leh leadam harishon dor dor vedorshav vechulei. heach achme leh, i tema dechama beruach kudesha deinnun zeminin lemete lealma. keman dechama bechachmeta ma deyete lealma. lav hachi, ella chama beena kulhu. vehahu diukena dezamminin lemekam beh bealma kulhu chama beena, may tama begin demiyyoma deitbere alma kulhu nafshan dezamminin lemekam bivne nasha kulhu kayymin kamme kudesha berich hu behahu diukena mammash dezamminin lemekam beh
180: Kegavvna da kol innun tzaddikayyay batar denafkin mehay alma kulhu nafshan salkan, vekudesha berich hu azmin lon diukena ochora leitlabbesha behu kegavvna dehavu behay alma, vegin kach kulhu kayymin kammeh vechama lon adam harishon beena.

Vei tema batar dechama lon la kayyme bekiyyumayyhu. ta chaze kol milloy dekudesha berich hu bekiyyuma innun vekayymu kammeh ad denachatu lealma. kegavvna da ketiv, (Devarim 29:14) ki et asher yeshno fo vegomer ha ukemuha dechulhu bene nasha dezamminin lemeheve bealma kulhu ishtechachu tamman.

Hacha it leistakkala deha ketiv et asher enennu fo vegomer umashma hanehu (kullehu) deyifkun meinnun dekayymu tamman, begin dichtiv immanu hayyom vela ketiv immanu omed hayyom. ella vadday (hacha) kulhu kayymu tamman ella dela itchazu leena, vegin kach ketiv immanu hayyom af al gav dela itchazun.

Vei tema may tama la itchazun hacha kema deitchazun leadam harishon dechama lon ena beena, veha hacha itchaze yattir. ella hacha kad ityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael chezu ochora vedargin illain havu chaman umistakkelan ena beena vehavu teivin leistakkala ulemechome bikara demarehon, uvegin kach chamu yekara illaa dekudesha berich hu bilchodoy vela meochora.

Veal da kulhu bene nasha dezamminin lekayyma bealma kulhu kayyme kamme kudesha berich hu beinnun diukenin mammash dezamminin lekayyma beh hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enecha veal sifrecha vegomer. galmi rau enecha. may tama begin dediukena ochora illaa havi kehay uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 18:32) umi tzur zulati elohenu. man tzayyayr tav detzayyayr (dechalil) kolla (da beda) kekudesha berich hu.
