Davar acher ki mi eloah, da raza demilla deha el kelala hu deitkelil mikkulhu dargin, vei tema deha el ihu darga ochora begin dichtiv (tehillim 7) el zoem bechol yom. ta chaze, deha let el mibbalade Adonai delav ihu bilchodoy vela itperash lealmin. veal da ketiv, (Shmuel 2 22:32) ki mi el mibbalade Adonai vegomer, umi tzur vegomer deha tzur lav ihu bilchodoy ella kolla chad kedichtiv, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim vegomer.

Ta chaze, ad la itgezar avraham hava memallel immeh miggo machaze bilchodoy kema deittemar dichtiv haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze vegomer. bammachaze. behahu chezu darga dechol diukenin itchazyayn beh, kema deittemar. vehay machaze ihu raza divrit.

Vei tema divgin kach ikre machaze begin deihu darga chezu dechol diukenin itchazyayn beh ucheden ikre machaze, ha amart (88 2) bekadmita dead la itgezar avraham la hava memallel immeh bar hay darga dela sharan aloy dargin ochoranin, vehasheta amart bammachaze chezu dechol dargin illain (ihu). veha ad la itgezar ketiv haya devar Adonai el avram bammachaze.

Ella hay darga chezu dechol dargin illain ihu uvechezu dedargin illain ittakkan. veaf al gav divhahu zimna deavraham la hava gazir hay darga bechezu dedargin illain ihu uvechol innun gevavnin ihu kaim. vechezu deinnun (101 1, vatzez 2) gevavnin kayyme techoteh chad miyyamina gavvavn chivvavr. chad missemala gavvavn sumak. chad dechalil mikkol gevavnin, veihu chezu dechol gevavnin illain dekayyme aleh. veal da behay chezu kaim aleh deavraham umallil immeh veaf al gav dela itgezar. kevan deitgezar ma ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram.

Ta chaze, machaze shadday (amar) ketiv bevilam. uveavraham ketiv machaze setam, ma ben hay lehay. ella machaze shadday illen diltatta (denafku) minneh veinnun chezu dileh. machaze setam machaze da hu Adonai (dechol chezu) dechol diukenin illain itchazyayn beh, uvegin kach ketiv beavraham machaze setam uvevilam machaze shadday.
Veal da ad la itgezar avraham hava leh hay darga kidamaran. kevan deitgezar miyyad vayyera Adonai el avram vegomer itchazun kulhu (shear)
181: Dargin al hay darga, vehay darga mallil immeh kedka chaze bishlimu. veavraham itkattar middarga ledarga veal bivrit keyayma kaddisha kedka chaze bishlimu

Ta chaze, kevan deitgezar avraham, nafak mearla veal bikyayma kaddisha veitattar beittera kaddisha veal bekiyyuma dealma kaim aleh, ucheden itkeyyaym alma begineh. begin dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. uchetiv (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram. beHei baram, beavraham. vecholla beraza chada kaim. uveshaata dekudesha berich hu achame leh leadam kol innun darin dealma, vechama lon kol chad vechad kol dara vedara kulhu kayme beginta deeden behahu diukena dezamminin lekayyma behay alma.

Veta chaze, ha ittemar kevan dechama leh ledavid delav beh chayyim kelal, tavah, veihu yehiv leh middileh 70 shenin, vegin kach havu leh leadam tesha meot utelatin shenin. veinnun shivin istallaku leh ledavid.
Umilla da raza dechachmeta ihu, dedavid let leh (yomin) bar shivin shenin meadam kadmaa, vecholla raza dechachmeta ihu. vechol ma diltatta kolla ihu beraza dilela.

Veta chaze, bechol innun diukenin denishmatin dealma kulhu ziuugin ziuugin kammeh. levatar kad atyayn lehay alma kudesha berich hu mezavvivg ziuugin. amar rabbi (yehuda) yitzchak kudesha berich hu (mezavvivg zivugin veamar) amar bat peloni lifloni. amar rabbi yose may ka mayyre veha ketiv, (Kohelet 1:9) en kol chadash tachat hashshemesh. amar rabbi yehuda tachat hashshemesh ketiv, shane leela.
Amar rabbi yose may karoza hacha. veha amar rabbi chizkiyya amar rabbi chiyyay behahi shaata mammash denafik bar nash lealma bat zugo izdammenat lo.

Amar rabbi abba zakkain innun tzaddikayyay denishmathon mitatterin kamme malka kaddisha ad la yetun lealma, dehachi taninan behahi shaata deappik kudesha berich hu nishmatin lealma, kol innun ruchin venishmatin kulhu kelilan dechar venukeva demitchabberan kechada.
Veitmasseran bida dehahu memanna shelicha deitpakkad al idduehon divne nasha. velayla shemeh, uveshaata denachatin veitmasran bidoy mitparshin, ulezimnin da akdim min da veachit lehu bivne nasha.

Vechad (macha) mata idan deziuuga dilhon. kudesha berich hu deyada innun ruchin venishmatin mechabbar lon kidbekadmita umachreza alayyhu. vechad itchabberan itavidu chad gufa chad nishmata yamina usemala kedka chaze, uvegin kach en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh.
Vei tema ha taninan let ziuuga ella lefum ovadoy vearchoy devar nash. hachi hu vadday. dei zache veovadoy itkashran, zache lehahu dileh leitchabbara beh kema denafik.

Amar ravi chiyyay man deitkashran ovadoy bean atar yitba (sefer acher yatva) hahu ziuuga dileh. amar leh ha taninan leolam yimkor adam kulei veyissa bat talmid chacham (davar acher 33 401 chaze). detalmid chacham pikdona demareh itpakdan bideh.

Tana beraza dematnitta kol innun deatu begilgula denishmatin yachlin leakdama berachame ziuuga dilhon. veal hay itaru chavrayay. (en nosin nashim bammoed aval mekaddeshin) shemma yekaddemennu acher berachamim. veshappir kaamru acher dayyka, veal ken kashin ziuugin kammeh dekudesha berich hu. veal kolla (panim) vadday ki yesharim darche Adonai ketiv.

Rabbi yehuda shalach leh lerabbi elazar amar ha raza demilla yedana, innun deatu begilgula denishmatin mean atar lehu ziuuga. shelach leh ketiv, (Shoftim 21:7) ma naase lahem lannotarim lenashim vegomer. uchetiv lechu vachataftem lachem vegomer. parshata divni vinyamin ochach veal hay taninan shemma yekadmennu acher berachamim. (ki oto achar en lo bat zugo, aval tishkach da kegon bar nash denasiv bat zugeh velo havo leh mane benin umet, yete achohi viyabbem itteteh vaytaylayd leh mane bar. hay bar hu meta daahaderat nishmateh lealma. da hu achar deen lo bat zug ella immeh, veda hu 341 yekaddemenu achar berachamim deyachil leakdema achara lemesav itteteh deda berachame uvitzlota veaf al gav daamena lecha deyachil leakdema berachame lo yachil ella im 1 balah chayyayva ihu veihu zakkaa)
182: Amar rabbi yehuda (hasheta) hay hu vadday dekashin ziuugin kamme kudesha berich hu. zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael deorayyta olif lehu archoy dekudesha berich hu, vechol temirin ugeniza dignizin kammeh.

Vadday ketiv, (Tehillim 19:8) torat Adonai temima vegomer. zakkaa chulakeh man deyishtadal beorayyta vela yitperash minah, dechol man deyitperash meorayyta afillu shaata chada kema deitperash mechayye dealma dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha. uchetiv, (Mishlei 3:2) orech yamim ushenot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach:

Vayhi avram ben tishim shana vegomer. rabbi yose patach (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael mikkol shear ammin, dekudesha berich hu kara lon tzaddikim. detanya mea veesrim (davar acher 33 vechamesh) utemanya alfe mare degaddefin deazlin vetasin kol alma veshamin kala veachadin leh lehahu kala.

Kema detaninan let lach milla bealma delet lah kala, veazla vetasa barkia, veachadin lah mare degadfin vesalkin hahu kala (davar acher lemarehon) deamrin (nusach acher demidyan) vedayynin lah hen letav hen levish dichtiv, (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol vegomer.

Ematay dayynin lehahu kala. rabbi chiyyay amar beshaata debar nash shachiv venaim, venishmeteh nafkat minneh, vehi ashidat beh bebar nash, ucheden dayynin lehahu kala hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:Adonai) mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha. may tama, mishshum dehi ashidat bevar nash. rabbi yehuda amar kol ma debar nash avid bechol yoma nishmateh ashidat beh bevar nash belelya.

Tana amar rabbi elazar bitchilat shaata kammayyta belelya kad nashaf yemama veal shimsha mare demaftechan dimmannan al shimsha al bitresar tarin diftichin bimama, batar deal bechulhu, kol innun tarin setimin (nusach acher pitchin),

Karoza kaim veshare leachraza, kaim man dekaim veachid leinnun maftechan, batar desiyyem karoza, kol innun neture alma mitkanshin vesalkin, let man defatach (puma) pitra kolla mishtakkechin. keden dinin diltatta mitarin veazlin veshatin bealma, vesihara share leanhara.

Umare divava takin umeyallelin. takin tinyaynut keden mitare shirata umezammerin kamme marehon, kamma mare teresin kayymu bekiyyumayyhu veitarin dinin bealma, keden bene nasha nayymin venishmata nafkat veashidat sahaduta veitchayyvat bedina, vekudesha berich hu avid chesed bevar nash venishmeta tavat leatrah.

Befalgut lelya kad tzipporin mitarin, sitra detzafon itar berucha, kam bekiyyumeh sharvita devistar darom uvatash behahu rucha veshachich veitbassam, keden itar kudesha berich hu benimusoy leishtashea im tzaddikayya beginta deeden.

Behahu shaata zakkaa chulakeh debar nash dekaim leishtaasha beorayyta, deha kudesha berich hu vechol tzaddikaya divginta deeden kulhu tzayytin lekaleh hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini.

Velo od ella dekudesha berich hu mashich aleh chad chuta dechesed lemeheve (davar acher 33 tadir) netir bealma, deha illain vetattain natrin leh hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya kol man deishtaddal behay shaata beorayyta vadday it leh chulaka tadir bealma deate. amar rabbi yose may tama taddir. amar leh hachi olifna dechol palgut lelya kad kudesha berich hu itar beginta deeden kol innun netian deginta ishtakyayn yattir mehahu nachala deikre
183: Nachal kedumim nachal adanim dela pasku memoy lealmin, kivyachol hahu dekaim veishtedal beorayyta keilu hahu nachala itrak al resheh veashke leh bego innun netian divginta deeden.
(Amar rabbi yose) velo od ella hoil vechulhu tzaddikayyay divgo ginta deeden tzayytin leh, chuleka shavyayn leh behahu shakyu denachala. ishtechach deit leh chulaka tadir bealma deate.

Rabbi abba hava ate mitverya leve teronya dechamuy, verabbi yaakov bereh hava immeh, iaru bichfar tarsha. kad bau lemishkav, amar rabbi abba lemareh deveta it hacha tarnegola. amar leh mara deveta, ammay. amar leh begin dekaimna befalgut lelya mammash.

Amar leh la itzterich, deha simana li beveta dehaden tikla dekamme arsay malina leh maya venatif tif tif, befalgut lelya mammash itraku kulhu maya, veitgalgal hay kitfa venahim, veishtema kaleh bechol beta, ucheden hu falgut lelya mammash, vechad sava hava li dahava kam bechol palgut lelya veishtaddal beorayyta, uvegine kach avad hay,

Amar ribbi abba berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, befalgut lelya nahim hahu galgala dekitfa, kamu ribbi abba veribbi yaakov. shamu lehahu gavra dahava yativ veshippule veta uterin benoy immeh, vahava amar ketiv (tehillim kayit sav) chatzot layla akum lehodot lecha al mishpete tzidkecha, may ka chama david deihu amar chatzot layla vela bachatzot layla. ella chatzot layla vadday, lekudesha berich hu amar hachi.
Vechi kudesha berich hu hachi ikre. in, deha chatzot layla mammash kudesha berich hu ishtechach vesiata dileh ucheden hi shaata deayil beginta deeden leishtashea im tzadikaya.

Amar rabbi abba lerabbi yaakov vadday nishtattef bishchinta venitchabbar kechada, karivu veyativu immeh, amru leh ema milla defumach deshappir kaamart. mena lach hay. amar lon milla da olifna missavay.

Vetu hava amar ditlat (nusach acher ditchillat) shaate kamayyta delelya kol dinin diltatta mitarin veazlin veshatin bealma. befalgut lelya mammash kudesha berich hu itar beginta deeden vedinin diltatta la mishtakkechan.

Vechol nimusin dilela belelya la ishtechachu ella befalgut lelya mammash. menalan meavraham dichtiv vayyechalek alehem layla. bemitzrayim (Shemot 12:29) vayhi bachatzi hallayla, uveatrin saggiin beorayyta hachi ishtechach. vedavid hava yada.

(Uma) umena hava yada. ella hachi amar sava. demalchuta dileh behay (lelya) talya. veal da kaim behahi shaata veamar shirata, ulehachi karye lekudesha berich hu chatzot layla mammash, akum lehodot lecha vegomer deha kol dinin talyayn mehacha, vedinin demalchuta mehacha mishtakkechin, vehahi shaata itketir bah david vekam veamar shirata. ata rabbi abba uneshakeh, amar leh vadday hachi hu berich rachamana deshadderani hacha.

Ta chaze, layla dina bechol atar veha okimna mille, vehachi hu vadday, veha itar kame derabbi shimon. amar hahu yenuka bereh dehahu gavra i hachi ammay ketiv chatzot layla. amar leh ha ittemar befalgut lelya malchuta dishmaya itarat. amar ana shemana milla. amar leh rabbi abba, ema beri tav deha milla defumach kala devutzina lehve.

Amar ana shemana deha layla dina demalchuta ihu uvechol atar dina hu, vehay dekaamar chatzot, begin deyanka bitre gavvni (chatzot) bedina vechesed, vadday palguta kadmita dina hu, deha palguta ochora nehiru anpaha besitra dechesed. veal da chatzot layla ketiv vadday.

Kam rabbi abba veshavve yedoy beresheh uvarcheh, amar vadday chashivna dechachmeta la ishtechach bar beinnun zakkae dezachu ba. hasheta chamena deafillu yenuke bedara derabbi shimon zachu lechachmeta ilaa. zakkaa ant rabbi shimon. vavy ledara deant tistallak minneh. yatvu ad
184: Patach rabbi abba veamar (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. milla da ha ukemuha chavrayay may tama ketiv veammech kullam tzaddikim, vechi kulhu yisrael tzaddike ninhu. veha kamma chayyayvin it behu beyisrael kamma chattain vechamma rashshiin deavrin al pikkude orayyta.

Ella hachi tana beraza dematnitin. zakkain innun yisrael deavdin karbana deraava lekudesha berich hu demakrivin benayyhu litmanya yomin lekarbana, vechad itgezaru alu behay chulaka tava dekudesha berich hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam. kevan dealu behay chulaka detzaddik ikrun tzaddikim, vadday kullam tzaddikim.

Veal ken leolam yirshu aretz. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 118:20) pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam. uchetiv ze hashshaar laAdonai tzaddikim yavou vo. innun deitgezaru veikrun tzaddikim. netzer mattaay. nitzer meinnun netiin denata kudesha berich hu beginta deeden hay eretz chad minayyhu, veal ken it lehu leyisrael chulaka tava bealma deate uchetiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz. (Yeshayahu 60:21) leolam yirshu aretz. mahu leolam. kema deokimna bematnitta dilan, veha ittemar hay milla ben chavrayay.

(Vetana may ka chama kera dela ikre avraham ad hasheta). (nusach acher ta chaze, kudesha berich hu lo kera leavraham avraham ad hasheta may tama. ella hachi okimna dead hasheta lo itgezar, vechad itgezar itchabbar beh hay hei vesharya beh), ella hachi okimna dead hasheta la itgezar, vechad itgezar itchabbar behay Adonai ushechinta sharya beh ucheden ikre avraham.

Vehayenu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram. vetana baAdonai beraam. vetana beavraham. may kaamre ella da chesed veda shechinta vecholla nachit kechada, vela kashya milla vehay vehay have.

Amar rabbi yaakov lerabbi abba hay Adonai dehibbaram zeira, vaAdonai (Devarim 32 6) dehallaAdonai ravreva, ma ben hay lehay, amar leh da (shechinta) shemita, veda yovla (veit dematne decholla chad, dechad minnahara matzdik keden kayyeyma beashlamuta vaAdonai ravreva, deha mitnahara kedka yeot, ulezimnin dela kayyeyma beashlamuta veyanka missitra achara keden hei zeera) uvegin kach zimnin desihara kayyma beashlamuta vezimnin bifgimuta, uveanpaha ishtechach veishtemoda vecholla shappir. vehay ihu berira demilla.

Amar rabbi abba zakkain innun yisrael dekudesha berich hu itrae behon mikkol shear amin, veyahiv lon at keyayma da, dechol man deit beh hay at, la nachit laggehinnom i ihu natir leh kedka yaut dela ayil leh birshuta ochora vela meshakker bishmeh demalka, dechol man dimshakker behay, keman dimshakker bishmeh dekudesha berich hu dichtiv, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki banim zarim yaladu.

Tu amar rabbi abba bezimna devar nash assik bereh leooleh lehay berit, kere kudesha berich hu lefammalya dileh veamar chamu may beriyya avadit bealma. beh shaata izdamman (leh) eliyahu vetas (46 2) alma bed tasin veizdamman tamman.
Veal da taninan devae bar nash letakkana kurseyay ochora likara dileh, veyema (13 1) da kurseyay deeliyyahu, vei lav la share tamman. vehu salik veashid kamme kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv, (Melachim 1 19:9-10) ma lecha fo eliyyahu vegomer. uchetiv kanno kineti laAdonai (elohe tzevaot) ki azvu beritcha bene yisrael vegomer. amar leh chayyecha bechol atar dehay reshima kaddisha yirshemun leh banay bivsarhon ant tizdamman tamman, ufuma deashid deyisrael azvu, hu yashid deyisrael mekayymin hay keyayma. veha taninan al ma itannash eliyyahu kamme kudesha berich hu al deamar diltora al benoy.

Adhachi hava ate nehora deyoma vehavu amare mille deorayyta. kamu lemezal. amar leh hahu gavra bamme deaskitu behay lelya ashlimu. amare may hu. amar lehu detechomun limchar anpoy demareh dekayayma, deha devitay baat bauta da minnayychu. ugezar keyayma divre deityeylid li, lemachar leheve hillula dileh. amar rabbi abba hay beuta demitzva ihu ulemechome appe shechinta netiv.
185: Behahu lelya kanash hahu gavra kol innun rechimoy, vechol hahu lelya ishtaddalu beorayyta vela hava man denaim, amar lehu hahu gavra bematu minnayychu kol chad vechad lema milla chadta deorayyta:

Patach chad (rabbi abba) veamar (Shoftim Adonai:2) bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnadev am barchu Adonai. may ka chamu devora uvarak defatchu behay kera. ella hachi taninan let alma mitkayyma ella al hay berit dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:20) im lo veriti yomam valayla vegomer deha shemaya veara al da kayymin.

Begin kach kol zimna deyisrael mekayymin hay berit, nimmuse shemaya veara kayymin bekiyyumayyhu, vechol zimna dechas veshalom yisrael mevattelin hay berit, shemaya veara la mitkayymin, uvirchan la mishtakkechin bealma.

Ta chaze, la shallitu shear ammin al yisrael ella kadd betilu minnayyhu keyayma da. uma betilu minayyhu. dela itparan vela itgalyayn. veal da ketiv vayyaazvu beni yisrael et Adonai vegomer vayyimkor otam beyad sisra, vayyaazvu et Adonai mammash. ad deatat devora veitnaddevat lechol yisrael bemilla da, keden itkenau sanehon techotayyhu.

Vehayeynu detaninan deamar kudesha berich hu lihoshua vechi yisrael atimin innun vela (ba 40 1) (70) itperau vela itgalyay vela kayymin keyayma dili, veat bae leoola lehu leara uleachnaa sanehon. (Yehoshua Adonai:2) shuv mol et beni yisrael shenit. vead deitperau veitgalleyay hay berit la alu leara vela itkenau sanehon. uf hacha kevan deitnaddevin yisrael behay at itkenau sanehon techotayyhu uvirchan itchazaru lealma hada hu dichtiv bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barchu Adonai.

Kam ochora patach veamar, (Shemot 4:24) vayhi vadderech bammalon vayyifgeshehu Adonai vayvakkesh hamito leman lemoshe. amar leh kudesha berich hu vechi at azil leappaka yat yisrael mimmitzrayim uleachnea malka rav veshallita, veat ansheyet minach keyayma. divrach la itgezar, miyyad vayvakkesh hamito.

Tana nachat gavriel beshalhova deesha leokdeh, veitremiz chad chivya mittokda leshafa leh begavveh. ammay chivya, amar leh kudesha berich hu at azil lekatla chivya ravreva vetakkifa uverach la itgezar. miyyad itremiz lechad chivya lekatla leh,
Ad dechamat tzippora vegazrat livrah veishteziv hada hu dichtiv vattikkach tzippora tzor. mahu tzor, ella asvavta. umay asvavta dichtiv vattichrot et arlat benah. denitznetza bah ruach kudesha.

Kam ochora veamar (Bereshit 45:4) vayyomer yosef el echav geshu na elay vayyiggashu vayyomer vegomer. vechi ammay kare lehu veha kerivin havu gabbeh. ella beshaata deamar lon ani yosef achichem. tevavhu dechamu leh bemalchu illaa. amar yosef malchu da begin da ravavchna leh, geshu na elay vayyiggashu, deachaze lehu hay keyayma demila, amar da garmat li malchu da begin denatrit lah.

Mikkan olifna man denatir lehay at keyayma malchu itnatrat leh. menalan mibboaz dichtiv, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker dehava mekatreg leh yitzreh ad deome omaa unetir lehay berit, begin chach zacha denafku minneh malchin shallitin al kol shear malchin, umalka meshicha deitkere bishma dekudesha berich hu:

Patach idach veamar ketiv, (Tehillim 27:3) im tachane alay machan vegomer. hachi tana bezot ani voteach, mahu bezot, da at keyayma dizmina tadir gabbe bar nash veitremiza leela, uvegine chach ittemar bezot kema dichtiv zot ot habberit. zot beriti. vecholla bechad darga. vetana ze vezot bechad darga innun vela mitparshan.
Vei tema i hachi ha shear bene alma hachi. ammay david bilchodoy vela ochora. ella begin deachida beh veitremiza beh vehu chitra demalchuta.
Ta chaze, begin dehay zot la natar leh david malka kedka chaze, malchuta
186: Itadde minneh kol hahu zimna. vehachi olifna hay zot itremiza bemalchuta dilela, veitremiza biyrushala 40 karta kaddisha.

Behahu shaata dedavid avar aleh, nafak kala veamar david bamme deitkatrat tishtere. lach tardin miyrushala 40 umalchuta itade minach. mena lan dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 12:11) hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetcha. mibbetcha dayyka vehachi hava bemma deavar beh itannash, uma david malka hachi shear bene alma al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach idach veamar (Tehillim 94:17) lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi. tana bamme zachan yisrael dela nachate laggehinnom kishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot vela itmasran bidoy deduma, (ella) behay at.

Dehachi tana beshaata debar nash nafik mealma kamma chavile (Malachi chabbala) tehirin itpakdan aleh. zekifin ena vechaman hay at dehu keyayma dekudesha, itparshan minneh, vela ityeyhiv bidoy deduma lenachata laggehinnom, dechol man deitmasar bidoy nachit laggehinnom vadday,
Umehay at dachalin illain vetattain, vedinin bishin la shaltin beh babbar nash i ihu zachi linture leh lehay at, begin dehu itachid bishma dekudesha berich hu.

Kevan dedavid malka la natar at keyayma da kedka chaze, itadde minneh malchuta veitterid miyrushalam. miyyad dachil desavar deyechatun leh miyyad veyimserun leh bidoy deduma veyamut behahu alma, ad deitbassar beh dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut. beh shaata patach veamar lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi.

Patach idach veamar may hay (dichtiv) deamar david vehareeni oto veet navihu. (may vehirani oto veachar kach veet navehu), man yachil lemechome leh lekudesha berich hu. ella hachi taninan behahi shaata deitgezar aleh hahu onasha, vedavid yada deal dela natar hay at kedka yeut itannash behay, decholla kechada achida, vecholla mitremiz behay at, vela ikre tzaddik man dela natar leh kedka yeut, hava bae beuteh veamar (Shmuel 2 15:25) vehareeni oto veet navihu.

May oto, (ot dileh ot habberit deha oto dekudesha berich hu, et dileh) da at keyayma (dileh) kaddisha deha dachilna deitavid minnay. may tama begin ditren illen malchuta viyrushala 40 behay achidan, uvegin kach tale bevauteh oto veet navehu deyithaddar malchuta dehay at leatreh. vecholla chad milla.

Patach idach veamar (Iyov 19:26) umibbesari echoze eloah, may umibbesari, umeatzmi mibbae leh. ella mibbesari mammash. umay hi. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 11:15) uvesar kodesh yaavru mealayich. uchetiv (Bereshit 17:13) vehayta beriti bivsarchem. detanya bechol zimna deitreshim bar nash behay reshima kaddisha dehay at, minneh chame lekudesha berich hu. minneh mammash. venishmeta kaddisha itachidat beh.
Vei la zache. dela natir hay at. ma ketiv, (Iyov 4:9) minnishmat eloah yovedu. deha reshimu dekudesha berich hu la itnetir. vei zache venatir leh, shechinta la itperash minneh.

Ematay mitkayyma beh kad itnesiv vehay at ayil beatreh, (metzuvvin detanya may tama vav hei azlin kachada, ella chad dechar vechad nukeba) ishtattafu kachada veikre chad shema, keden chesed illaa sharyay alayyhu. bean atar sharya besitra didchura. uman chesed chesed el deate venafak mechachma illaa veitattar bidchura uvegin kach itbasmat nukeva. (nusach acher ditnan raza 26 hei azlin kachada kegavvna didchar venukeba ishtattafu kachada veinnun chad, keden chesed illaa sharyay alayyhu veitattar bidchura vaatabesamet nukeba).
Tu taninan eloah hachi hu amar leh nehiru dechachmeta. 6 dechar Adonai nukeva. ishtattafu kechada eloah ikre. venishmeta kaddisha mehay atar itachdat, vecholla talya behay at.

Veal da ketiv umibbesari echeze eloah. da shelemuta decholla, mibbesari mammash, mehay at mammash, veal da zakkain innun yisrael kaddishin deachidan beh bekudesha berich hu, zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai vegomer, uvegin kach chayyim kullechem hayyom.
Amar rabbi abba uma bechol kach attun chakkimin veattun yatvin hacha, amru leh i tzipporaa yitakru meatrayyhu
187: La yadin lean tasan hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:8) ketzippor nodedet min kinnah ken ish noded mimkomo.

Veatra da zache lan leorayyta, vehay orcha dilan. bechol lelya palguta anan nayymin, ufalguta anan askin beorayyta. vechad anan kayymin betzafra reche chakla venahare maya, neharin lan orayyta, veityayshshavta belibban.

Ha dayynuha leela zimna chada. vechamma sarche terisin istallaku behahu dina al onsha (75, 101 2) deorayyta, ucheden ishtaddeluta dilan yemama velelya beorayyta hu, veatra da ka mesayya lan, uman deitperash mikkan, keman deitperash mechayye alma.

Zakif yedoy rabbi abba uvarich lon. yatvu ad denahar yemama. batar denahar yemama amru leinnun dardeke dekamayyhu puku vechamu i nahar yemama, vechol chad lema milla chadta deorayyta lehay gavra rabba.

Nafku vechamu denahar yemama. amar chad minnayyhu zammin hay yoma esha milleela. amar ochora uvehach beta. amar ochora chad sava hacha dezammin hay yoma leittokda benura da, amar rabbi abba rachamana lishezvan.

Tavav vela yachil lemallala, amar kutera dehuremana beara ittafsat. vechach hava, dehahu yoma chamu chavrayay appe shechinta veistacharu beesha. verabbi abba itlahitu anpoy kenura mechedvavta deorayyta.

Tana kol hahu yoma la nafku kulhu mibbeta uveta itkattar bekitra, vehavu chadtan mille begavavyyhu, keillu kibbelu hahu yoma orayyta mittura desinay. batar deistallaku la havu yade i hu yemama vei lelya. amar rabbi abba beod deanan kayymin lema kol chad minan milla chadta dechachmeta leakshera tivu lemareh deveta mareh dehillula:

Patach chad veamar (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha vegomer. bekadmita chatzerecha levatar betecha ulevatar hechalecha. da penimaa min da, veda leela (nusach acher lego) min da. yishkon chatzerecha bekadmita, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40 kadosh yeamer lo.

Nisbea betuv betecha levatar kema deat amer, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yivne vayit. hachachma yivne vayit la ketiv, dei ketiv hachi, hava mashma dechachma bayit ikre, ella ketiv bechachma yivne vayit, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan vegomer.
Kedosh hechalecha levatar da hu shelimu decholla, dehachi taninan mahu hechol. kelomar 15 50, hay vehay. vecholla ishtelim kechada.

Resha dekra ma mochach dichtiv ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha. hay man deakriv bereh karbana kamme kudesha berich hu, raava dekudesha berich hu behahu karbana veitree beh vekariv leh veshavve medoreh bitren idrin veachid lehay ulehay deinnun teren itkashsheru kechada. dichtiv yishkon chatzerecha. chatzerecha vadday tere.

Begine chach chaside kadmae savan dehacha kad makrivin benayyhu lekarbana da. patche veamre ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha. innun dekayyme alayyhu amre nisbea betuv betecha kedosh hechalecha. levatar mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehacheniso bivrito shel avraham avinu. veinnun dekayyme alayyhu amre keshem shehichnasto labberit vechulei.

Vetaninan bekadmita libbae bar nash rachamin aleh ulevatar al ochora dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:17) vechipper baado bekadmita ulevatar uvead kol kehal yisrael. veanan orcha da naktinan vehachi shappir vechaze lekamman.

Amar rabbi abba vadday kach hu veyaot milla, uman dela amar hachi appik garmeh measara chuppot dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad letzaddikayya bealma deate, vechulhu mitkashran behay. uvegine chach asara mille dimhemnuta it behay kera ashre tivchar utekarev vegomer. vechol milla umilla chad chuppa itavid minnah.
Zakkaa chulakechon bealma da uvealma deate, deha orayyta mitkashshera belibbayychu keillu kayymitu
188: Begufayychu betura desinay beshaata deityehivat orayyta leyisrael:

Patach idach veamar (Shemot 20:21) mizbach adama taase li vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha vegomer. tana kol man dekariv bereh lekarbana da, keillu akriv kol karbanin dealma lekammeh dekudesha berich hu, ucheillu bane madbecha shelemata kammeh.
Begine chach bae lesaddera madbecha bemana chad malyay ara lemigzar aleh hay keyayma kaddisha, veitchashshiv kamme kudesha berich hu keillu adbach aleh ilavvavn vekarbanin ana vetore.

Venicha leh yattir mikkulhu dichtiv vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha vegomer. bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi. mahu azkir et shemi (et) da mila dichtiv bah (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam.
Hay mizbach adama vadday kema deamina. batreh ma ketiv veim mizbach avanim taase li. remez legiyyora kad itgayyayr deihu meam keshe kedal ukeshe libba, hay ikre mizbach avanim.
Lo tivne ethen gazit. ma hu, devae leaala leh befulechana dekudesha berich hu (begin) vela yigzar yateh ad deyinshe pulechana ochora deavad ad hacha veyaade minneh hahu kashyu delibba.

Vei itgezar vela aade minneh hahu kashya delibba lemeal befulechana kaddisha dekudesha berich hu, hare hu kehay pesila deavna degazre leh mehay gisa umehay gisa veishtaar avna kidbekadmita. vegin kach lo tivne ethen gazit. dei ishtaar bekashyuteh, ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechallaleha, kelomar hahu geziru deitgezar la mehaneya leh.

Begine chach zakkaa chulakeh deman deakriv hay karbana bechedvavta beraava kamme kudesha berich hu, uvae lemechode behay chulaka kol (davar acher 33 hahu) yoma dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:12) veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha:

Patach idach veamar vayhi avram ben tishim shana vetesha shanim vayyera Adonai vegomer ani el shadday hithallech lefanay vegomer. hay kera it leayyna beh vekashya bechamma orchin, vechi ad hasheta la itgeli leh kudesha berich hu leavraham ella (74) haidna kad mata lehanne yomin vayyera Adonai el avram vela kodem. vehachtiv vayyomer Adonai el avram. vaAdonai amar el avram. vayyomer leavram yadoa teda vegomer. vehaidna mane chusheban yomin, vechad mani lehu ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram, ishtema dead hasheta la itgeli aloy. veod dichtiv ben tishim shana vetesha shanim, bekadmita shana ulevasof shanim.

Ella hachi tana, kol innun yomin la ketiv vayyera, may tama, ella kol kamma dehava atim vesatim (kach) kudesha berich hu la itgeli aleh kidkachaze. haidna itgeli aleh dichtiv vayyera. may tama. mishshum devaa legalle beh hay at kitra kaddisha.

Veod devaa kudesha berich hu leafaka minneh zara kaddisha, vekaddisha la leheve beod deihu atim bisra, ella amar hasheta dehu ben tishim shana vetesha shanim uzeman kariv hu deyinpok minneh zara kaddisha, lehve hu kaddisha bekadmita ulevatar yinpok minneh zara kaddisha. vegin kach mane yomoy behay vela bechol hanne zimni kadmita.
Tu tishim shana, dechol yomoy kadmae la havu shanim ella kechad shana dela havu yomoy yomin, hasheta demata lehay shanim, innun vela shana:

Vayyomer elav ani el shadday. may mashma dead hasheta la kaamar ani el shadday. ella hachi tana, avad kudesha berich hu kitrin tattain dela kaddishin letatta. vechol innun dela itgezzaru yistaavun behon.

Ureshimin behon, umay rishshuma it behon, deitchaze behu 360 dalet vela yattir, uvegin kach istaavun behu veitdabbekun behu. batar deitgezaru nafkin meillen vealin begadfoy dishchinta veitgalleya behu yod reshima kaddisha at keyayma shelim
189: Veitreshim behu 314 veishtelim bekiyyuma shelim, veal da ketiv behay ani el shadday.

Hithallecha lefanay vehye tamim, shelim, dehashta at chaser birshima deshyn vedlt, gezar garmach veheve shelim birshima deyud. uman deihu berishshuma da itchaze leitbarcha bishma da dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:3) veel shadday yevarech otcha.

Mahu el shadday. hahu devirchan nafkan minneh, hu deshallit al kitrin tattain, vecholla middachalteh dachalin umizdazein, vegin kach man deitgezar, kol innun dela kaddishin itrachakan minneh vela shaltin beh. vela od ella dela nachit laggehinnom dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. (kol innun 1 deitgezaru ikrun tzaddikim, uvegin kach leolam yarshu eretz, dela yarit hay eretz ella hahu deikre tzaddik, uf hachi veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yarshu eretz vego)

Amar rabbi abba zakkain attun bealma den uvealma deate, zakkaa chulaki deatena lemishma millin illen mippumechon, kulchu kaddishin, kulchu bene elaha kaddisha, alayychu ketiv, (yeshaya ma) ze yomar laAdonai ani veze yikra beshem yaakov veze yichtov yado laAdonai uveshem yisrael yechanne. kol chad minnechon achid veitkashshar bemalka kaddisha illaa, veattun ravrevan memannan teresin mehahi eretz deikre eretz hachayyim deravrevanohi achlin mimmanna detalla kaddisha:

Patach idach veamar (Kohelet 10:17) ashrecha eretz shemmalkech ben chorin vesarayich baet yochelu. uchetiv i lach eretz shemmalkech naar vesarayich babboker yochelu. hanne kerae kashyayn ahadade. vela kashyayn, hay dichtiv ashrech eretz, da eretz dilela deshalta al kol innun chayyin dilela. uvegin kach ikre eretz hachayyim, vealah ketiv, (Devarim 11:12) eretz asher Adonai elohecha doresh otah tamid. uchetiv eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem lo techsar kol bah. lo techsar kol bah dayyka. vechol kach lamma, mishshum dichtiv shemmalkech ben chorin da kudesha berich hu. kema deat amer, (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael.

Ben chorin, mahu ben chorin kema deat amer, (Vayikra 25:10) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem. uchetiv ukeratem deror baaretz deha kol cheru miyyovla ka ate. vegin kach ben chorin. vei tema ben chorin vela ketiv ben cherut. hachi hu vadday ben cherut mibbae leh.

Ella bematnitta setimaa dilan tanina. kad mitchabberan yod baAdonai keden ketiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. vela tema kad mitchabberan, ella mitchabberan vadday. uvegin kach ben chorin ketiv, veal da ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin, vesarayich baet yochelu bechedvavta bishlimu beraava.

I lach eretz shemmalkach naar, hay eretz diltatta, detanya kol shear are dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ityehivu leravrevin teresin dimmannan alayyhu, veela mikkulhu hahu dichtiv beh (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. vetana hay kera saro shel olam amaro. veal da ketiv i lach eretz shemmalkech naar. vavy lealma demissitra da yanka, vechad yisrael begaluta yankin keman deyannik mershuta ochora.

Vesarayicha babboker yochelu vela bechule yoma. babboker vela bezimna ochora deyoma. detanya beshaata dechamma zorachat veatyayn vesagdin leh leshimsha rugeza tale bealma, beshaata demincha rugeza talyay bealma. man garim hay, mishshum demalkech naar hahu deikre naar.

Veattun zakkae keshot kaddishe elyonin bene malka kaddisha la yankin mehay sitra, ella mehahu atar kaddisha dilela. alayychu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom:

Patach rabbi abba veamar (Yeshayahu Adonai:1) ashira na lididi shirat dodi lecharmo vegomer. vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu vegomer. hanni kerae it leistakkela behu. ammay ketiv shira, tochacha mibbae leh. lididi, ledodi mibbae leh. kema dichtiv shirat dodi. kerm haya lididi bekeren ben shamen. istakkalna bechol orayyta vela ashkachna atra deikre
190: Ella hanni kerae ha ukemuha chavrayay bechamma gevavnin vechulhu shappir vehachi hu, aval ashira na lididi, da yitzchak dehava yedid, veikre yedid ad la yippuk lealma.
Ammay yedid, detaninan rechimu sagge hava leh lekudesha berich hu beh dela itavid ad dela itgezar avraham avuha veikre shelim veittosaf leh hei leashlamuta. vechen lesara hay hei ityehivat lah.

Hacha it leistakkala, Adonai lesara shappir, aval leavraham ammay hei vela yod, 10 mibbae leh deha hu dechar hava. ella raza illaa hava (davar acher hu) satim begavvavn avraham salik leela venatil raza (110 1) meh illaa deihu alma didchura. hei illaa veh tattaa, hay talya bidchura, vehay benukeva vadday. uvegin chach avraham salik beHei deela, vesara nachata beHei deltatta.

Tu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha. vetana zarecha, zarecha mammash, dehava share lemeal behay keyaym, uman deshare lemeal behay keyaym al. uvegine chach giyyora deitgezar (338 lecha 165) ger tzedek ikre begin dela ata miggiza kaddisha deitgezaru, veal da man deal behay shemeh kehay

Avraham, vegin kach ketiv beh ko yihye zarecha, zarecha mammash. veitmasar leh hei. vei lav diitmasar hei lesara hava leh leavraham leolid letatta kema dehay 25 olidat letatta. batar deitmasrat hei lesara itchabbaru teren 70 kechada veolidu leela, umay denafak minnayyhu hu yod, begini chach yod at resha deyitzchak dechar. mikkan share dechura leitpashsheta, veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 21:12) ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara. beyitzchak vela becha. yitzchak olid leela dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. yaakov ashlim kolla.

Vei tema vechi avraham behay itachid vela yattir, veha ketiv chesed leavraham. ella chulaka dileh kach hu begin deavid chesed im bene alma. aval leolada hacha achid umehacha share. veal da la itgezar avraham ella ben tishim vetesha shana. veraza demilla ha ityeyda veokimna bematnitta dilan.

Uvegin kach yitzchak dina kashya nafak leachada lechulakeh, uleolada vechesed ikre, veal da yaakov ashlim kolla mehay sitra umehay sitra, missitra deachidu avraham veyitzchak lechulakehon leela hu shelemuta. missitra deityehiv lehu leolada mittatta leela hu shelemuta. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar. beh itachidu gevavnin meela umittatta.
Veal da ketiv hacha shira dichtiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:1) ashira na lididi. shira vadday, deha ikre leolada dechar, deha ikre yedid ad la yippuk lealma.
Veit deamre (da) ashira na lididi da avraham kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 11:15) ma lididi beveti. veavraham yarit yeruta deachsanat chulaka da, aval (al) ma deamina deda yitzchak hachi hu.
Shirat dodi lecharmo. da kudesha berich hu deikre dodi dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:10) dodi tzach veadom. yedidi, achid bedodi dechar uminneh itneta kerem, dichtiv kerm haya lididi.

Bekeren ben shamen. may bekeren ben shamen. ella bemma nafik hay kerm uvemma itneta, chazar veamar bekeren. may keren dichtiv, (Yehoshua 6:Adonai) bekeren hayyovel. bekeren hayyovel. share. vehay keren itachid behahu dechar deikre ben shamen.

Mahu ben shamen kema deat amer ben chorin. vetarvavyyhu chad milla, shemen demittamman negid mishcha urevu leadlaka botzinin, uvegin kach ben shamen. veda shemen urevu negid unefik veadlik botzinin ad denatil leh vechanish leh hay keren, veda ikre keren hayyovel. begine chach let meshichuta demalchuta ella bekeren, veal da itmeshach malchuta dedavid deitmeshach bekeren veitachid beh.
Vayazkehu, (vaysakkelehu) kehay izka deistachar lechol sitrin.
191: Vaysaklehu, deaade minneh umechulakeh kol innun ravrevin kol innun teresin kol innun kitrin tattain, vehu nasiv leh lehay (keren) kerm lechulakeh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

Vayyittaehu sorek, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek, kollo zera emet. 55 ketiv beHei. mikkan share avraham leolada leela, umehay nafak zera emet. kollo zera emet vadday, hayeynu dichtiv ko yihye zarecha, vecholla chad milla. zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael deyartoy ruta kaddisha da.
Sofeh dikra (Yeshayahu Adonai:2) vayyiven migdal betocho. mahu migdal kema deat amer, (Mishlei 18:10) migdal oz shem Adonai, venisgav. bo yarutz tzaddik vadday.
Vegam yekev chatzev bo da tara detzedek kema deat amer, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. may mashma, dechol bar yisrael deitgezar, ayyil betarvavyyhu vezache letarvavyyhu.

Uman dekariv bereh lekarbana da ayyil leh bishma kaddisha, veal at da mitkayymin shemaya veara dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. vehay mareh dehillula da zacha lecholla lemechoze kudesha berich hu anpin beanpin behay yoma.

Zakkaa chulakana dezachina lehay yoma vezakkaa chulakach immana, vehay bera deityeylid lach karena aleh kol hannikra bishmi vegomer yetzartiv af asitiv. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai vegomer. ozfuha lerabbi abba telat milin.
